Oh, don't look so scandalised. This is definitely not the first time you've done this. Quil may have grown up to become the age's great songstress, but you - you can be the most prolific killer in the history of the Realms! It will be easy - you can do it in your sleep!

objectives.title: What happened to Alfira?
journalEntries: What a corpse Alfira left! Blood crusting thick and dark 'round the eyes like a rushed coat of stage make-up. A sigil lovingly painted in blood, as if the killer was hoping to get caught. What visionary could have done this?

objectives.title: What happened to Quil?
journalEntries: What a corpse Quil left! Blood crusting thick and dark 'round the eyes like a rushed coat of stage make-up. A sigil lovingly painted in blood, as if the killer was hoping to get caught. What visionary could have done this?

objectives.title: Trust the Butler.
journalEntries: Sceleritas Fel is a murderer's murderer. He will set you right. Don't worry, as I'm sure you can tell, you can't help but be a prodigy spree-killer. It's in your perfect nature. While you may have forgotten your past, you can't forget what you were best at! Just follow your Butler. You can trust him!

Well, that's embarrassing. Your Butler ended up getting the pleasure of killing the bard instead of you. Given your perfect instincts, this surely won't happen again. With the Butler here to guide you, nothing can go amiss.

objectives.title: Go on! Kill another one!
journalEntries: You like to indulge those Urges of yours. Good. It doesn't matter that you have amnesia. The instincts in your body are kicking in, and you are behaving like your old sinner self again. The Dark Urge is back, back with bloody style.

objectives.title: Stop resisting the Urge!
journalEntries: It's been a rough tenday. Everything hurts, your headache is just getting worse, and the tadpole is a nuisance. It's hard to find the inspiration to lift your daggers for pleasure after a long day. But you're denying yourself the one outlet you have: murder! Nothing compares. Try it! After all, you're going to reap death upon the world sooner or later. Make it sooner!

objectives.title: Kill that sweet cleric!
journalEntries: Is-o-bel. Cleric of Selûne. Defender of Last Light. Died summer 1492 DR. Slap it on a headstone - doesn't it sound right? The Butler told you to kill her. The Butler knows what's best for you. He knows how to get your old life back. Isn't that all you want? To find out who you were, and get back to being that glorious old butcher?

objectives.title: You met the cleric and you didn't kill her?
journalEntries: You didn't intend to spare the cleric, did you? Surely not. You're just waiting for the perfect, tragic moment to strike. Build up her trust in you... Then let her fall. Yes, that must be your plan. Go back and kill her. Run along.

objectives.title: Reflect on your misbehaviour.
journalEntries: The Butler gave you another chance. Kill your darling. But you didn't - you spent the night tied up, playing out a farce as a wriggling, squirming slug. Humiliating. You can be so much more than that screaming heap. Come back to yourself.

The Butler gave you another chance. Kill your darling. But you didn't - you spent the night tied up, playing out a farce as a wriggling, squirming slug. Humiliating. You can be so much more than that. Come back to yourself.

objectives.title: Await your blood-prize.
journalEntries: Isobel is a corpse carried away on the wind. Last Light is desecrated. Such a sublime release of all your pent-up frustration. You did well, and this deed will not go without proper acknowledgement.

So, you killed your dearest. No one will ever love you now. Might as well take pleasure in being feared. You already enjoy fear. Deep down, you know you could have stopped your Urge last night. But it just felt too good - that last moment of fear. That final 'why?' That's who you are!

objectives.title: Enjoy the Slayer. You've earned it.
journalEntries: The Slayer now ravages your body. When it is dormant, you feel it champing at the bit. When it is summoned, you dissolve into the beast. It is an ancient symbol of hate. Hate well. You've earned it.

objectives.title: Return to the Temple of Bhaal.
journalEntries: You had a vision divine. The truth is restored: you are a pureblood Spawn of Bhaal. The former head of his Temple. Return, and kill sister Orin who usurped your place. Return, and restore your birthright: to lead the cult of murder until all in this world dies by your hand.

objectives.title: DESTROY THE GATE IN BHAAL'S NAME!
journalEntries: YOU ARE BHAAL'S DREAD PROPHET, THE CHOSEN ORDAINED TO BE THE LAST LIVING BEING. WHEN ALL ELSE HAS BEEN REAPED BY YOUR HAND, THE FINAL DEATH IN THESE FOUL PLANES SHALL BE YOUR OWN. TAKE COMMAND OF THE ELDER BRAIN. TAKE COMMAND OF ITS POSSESSED ARMIES. SET THEM UPON SLAUGHTER OF USELESS FAERÛN, THEN UPON EVERY FRAIL LIFE IN THIS COSMOS. Congratulations, Dark Urge. You're a champion!

objectives.title: Who am I? I can choose...
journalEntries: I escaped. The hold that Bhaal had over me is gone. All the voices in my head, and the rushes in my blood - I cured them at last! It's strange to think, but I can do whatever I want to. Be whoever I want to! I'm finally me. These thoughts won't talk to me any longer.

You believe that by disappointing Bhaal, you can escape him? You bear his unholy taint in your blood. After two hundred years, you are the only pureblood Bhaalspawn left. The Urge is going to eat you right up. Nothing will be left in your brain, but the will of Father dearest. Perhaps if you do what Bhaal would have wanted and follow through with the Absolute's plan to enslave the world, your mind might be spared his sickening lash.

entries.name: Vlaakith's Will
entries.description: Lae'zel Origin Subquest. Orpheus will die by my hand, and I will be named Baht t'Vlaakith.

objectives.title: Kill Orpheus once he is freed.
journalEntries: Vlaakith appeared to me in camp and made an offer: kill Orpheus, and she will ascend me to the Astral Plane and anoint me as her Chosen. I agreed to honour her command. Orpheus will die by my hand, and I will be named Baht t'Vlaakith.

objectives.title: Kill Orpheus once the Netherbrain is defeated.
journalEntries: I have freed Orpheus, and he lives - for now. I can slay him when the Netherbrain has fallen and the prince is no longer of use to me.

objectives.title: Quest complete
journalEntries: Orpheus is no more; Vlaakith's will is done. When I ascend, I will become Baht t'Vlaakith - Vlaakith's Chosen.
The Prince of the Comet lives, and is soon to ride the Astral Plane atop his great dragon. In Vlaakith's eyes, I will be forever Hshar'lak - a traitor.
Orpheus has taken his own life. Vlaakith's will is done. When I ascend, I will become Baht t'Vlaakith - Vlaakith's Chosen.

entries.name: Explore the Ruins
entries.description: We met some bandits near some ruins. They've been trying to break into a crypt - with no success. Whatever they're after is probably still inside.

objectives.title: Find a way into the ruins.
journalEntries: We met some bandits near some ruins. They've been trying to break into a crypt - with no success. Whatever they're after is probably still inside.
One of the druids' books mentioned a hidden cache in some abandoned ruins to the south of the grove. We should find a way into these ruins.
Shadowheart was trying to get into a building to look for supplies. We should see if there's anything useful in there.

objectives.title: Investigate the ruins.
journalEntries: We found a way into the abandoned ruins.
We've entered some ruins through an underground cave. There's bound to be some interesting artefacts down here.
We've entered some kind of crypt. It doesn't look like anyone has been here in a while - there might still be some valuable artefacts lying around.
We found a locked door, but it doesn't have a keyhole. There's got to be something interesting behind it.
The strange door led deeper into the ruins. There are bound to be some interesting artefacts down here.

objectives.title: Open the sarcophagus.
journalEntries: We found a large sarcophagus hidden in the ruins. Who lies within?

objectives.title: Talk to the strange figure.
journalEntries: A strange figure emerged from one of the sarcophagi we opened. Seems like he has something to say.
The plaque by the sarcophagus mentioned a 'Guardian of Tombs'. Could it be the strange figure who offered us help?
That strange figure found our camp. What does he want?

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: The strange figure admitted he was the 'Guardian of Tombs' and that he'd been sealed within one of the ruins' sarcophagi. He was likely the ruins' greatest secret.
The strange figure said he would see us again soon. He was probably the ruins' greatest secret, but there's no harm in checking for more valuables.
That strange figure somehow found our camp. He was probably the ruins' greatest secret, but there could still be some treasure down there.
We never ended up exploring the abandoned ruins.

entries.name: Free Lae'zel
entries.description: We found Lae'zel, the githyanki from the nautiloid, trapped in a hanging cage. Two tieflings are deciding what to do with her.

objectives.title: Resolve the conflict.
journalEntries: We found Lae'zel, the githyanki from the nautiloid, trapped in a hanging cage. Two tieflings are deciding what to do with her.
We entered Lae'zel's mind.
Lae'zel said she knew of a cure for the parasite. We won't find out what it is unless we help her get rid of the tieflings.

objectives.title: Free Lae'zel.
journalEntries: The tieflings refuse to leave. We need a new plan.
We convinced the tieflings to leave Lae'zel with us.
We convinced the tiefling to leave Lae'zel where she was.
We defeated the tiefling scouts, but Lae'zel remains caged.
The tieflings have been dealt with. Lae'zel demanded that we release her from her cage.

objectives.title: Defeat the tieflings.
journalEntries: The tieflings refused to walk away and attacked us.
After Lae'zel was released, we sided with her against the tieflings.
We released Lae'zel from her cage, and the tieflings attacked us.
We attacked the tieflings.

objectives.title: Speak with Lae'zel.
journalEntries: We convinced the tieflings to walk away.

objectives.title: Recruit Lae'zel.
journalEntries: Lae'zel has been released from the cage. We should speak with her.

objectives.title: Wait for the tieflings to open the cage.
journalEntries: We convinced the tieflings to help us kill Lae'zel.

objectives.title: Open the cage.
journalEntries: We convinced the tiefling that Lae'zel should be killed.

objectives.title: Kill Lae'zel.
journalEntries: After Lae'zel was released, we sided with the tieflings against her.
We remained neutral when Lae'zel asked us for help, and she attacked us.

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: Lae'zel has joined the party.
We invited Lae'zel to our camp.
After Lae'zel was released, we didn't invite her to join our party.
We defeated Lae'zel.
Lae'zel is dead.
We left Lae'zel to her fate.

entries.name: Find Doni
entries.description: As the tieflings prepare for the siege, Rikka asked us to find Doni and bring him to safety.

objectives.title: Find Doni
journalEntries: As the tieflings prepare for the siege, Rikka asked us to find Doni and bring him to safety.

objectives.title: Return to Rikka
journalEntries: We found Doni staring at the door to the druids' lair. He left for the children's hideout.

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: Rikka was grateful and thanked us for finding Doni.
Rikka died.
We betrayed the tieflings' trust - Rikka won't want to deal with us anymore.
We left the region without helping Rikka.
The siege began before we could bring any news to Rikka.

entries.name: Find Your Belongings
entries.description: We've been robbed - by children no less. They distracted us by posing as merchants. We should have a word with them.

objectives.title: Speak to the thieves.
journalEntries: We've been robbed - by children no less. They distracted us by posing as merchants. We should have a word with them.
A tiefling child told us we've been robbed. We should have a word with the thieves.

objectives.title: Find the thieves' hideout.
journalEntries: We learned that the leader of the thieves is called Mol. She might have our belongings.
We learned that the thieves have a hideout somewhere underground, and it has a hidden entrance.
We can't fit through the hideout's entrance. There must be another way in.
We learned that the leader of the thieves is called Mol. Her gang has a hideout somewhere underground. Our belongings must be there.

objectives.title: Find our stolen belongings.
journalEntries: We arrived in the thieves' hideout. It's time to get our stuff back.
Mol has our things. She must be keeping them in her underground hideout.
Mol admitted that she has our belongings. She offered to sell them back to us, but we refused the deal.

objectives.title: Quest Compete
journalEntries: Mol admitted that she has our belongings. She gave us the pickpocket's bag.
We finally got back our stolen belongings.
We were robbed, but we convinced the pickpocket to return what was stolen.
Mol gave back our belongings - some of them, anyway. The rest have gone missing.
Mol admitted that she has our belongings. Since we're on good terms, she was happy to return them.
We weren't able to get our stolen belongings back.
The thieves fled the hideout with our belongings. We probably won't see our stuff again.
We left the region before we could get our stolen items back.

entries.name: Get Help from Healer Nettie
entries.description: Aradin told us that the druid Halsin has an apprentice. If we can find her, she might be able to help us with the parasite.

objectives.title: Find the druid's apprentice.
journalEntries: Aradin told us that the druid Halsin has an apprentice. If we can find her, she might be able to help us with the parasite.

objectives.title: Find the healer Nettie.
journalEntries: When we asked about healing, we were told to look for Nettie in the Inner Sanctum.
There's a camp nearby where someone named Nettie can supposedly heal any wound. She might be able to help remove the parasite.

objectives.title: Follow Nettie.
journalEntries: We told Nettie about the parasite. She seemed concerned and asked us to follow her to another room for treatment.

objectives.title: Find an antidote for the poison.
journalEntries: Unable to heal us, Nettie spared us the horror of ceremorphosis - by poisoning one of us with deadly venom. We need to cure the poison immediately.
Nettie's corpse told us of a cure - the Elixir of Silvanus. It seems related to flora of the Dalelands.
To make the lifesaving antidote, we need to mix a bundle of mugwort in a cauldron of theriac, blessed by Silvanus.

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: Nettie tried to poison us, but we managed to talk her out of it. She let us go, but she made us promise to kill ourselves if we started to turn.
We managed to find a cure for the venom Nettie used - but we're still no closer to a cure for the parasite.
We rescued Nettie's master, Halsin. Now that he's safe, we don't need to ask Nettie for help - we can go directly to the master druid instead.
Nettie was killed before she could help us. We'll need to find another way to cure ourselves.
Nettie's dead - serves her right for trying to poison us. But it's a bittersweet victory: we still need to find a way to deal with the parasite.
We left the area without seeing if the druid apprentice could heal us.

entries.name: Investigate Kagha
entries.description: The Rite of Thorns is dangerous magic. Why is Kagha so determined to do this? We should investigate.

objectives.title: Search the Emerald Grove.
journalEntries: The Rite of Thorns is dangerous magic. Why is Kagha so determined to do this? We should investigate.

objectives.title: Investigate the Swamp.
journalEntries: We found a note addressed to Kagha that mentioned a meeting in the swamp. What is she up to?

objectives.title: Confront Kagha.
journalEntries: We found a note proving that Kagha is in league with the Shadow Druids. This could explain why she wants the tieflings gone.
A second note proved that Kagha is in league with the Shadow Druids. This could explain why she wants the tieflings gone.

objectives.title: Fight the Shadow Druids.
journalEntries: (Kagha lives) "We persuaded Kagha to turn against the Shadow Druids. It's time to end this.
(Kagha hostile) "Kagha refused to abandon her plans. It's time to end this.

objectives.title: Return to Zevlor.
journalEntries: We defeated the Shadow Druids and stopped the ritual. We should report our success to Zevlor.

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: (Kagha lived) "We exposed Kagha but were able to convince her to abandon the Shadow Druids. After fighting them, she stopped the ritual. The grove remains open.
(Kagha died) "We exposed Kagha and fought the Shadow Druids. Kagha is dead, and her ritual has been stopped. The grove remains open.
The tieflings have been forced out of the grove, and the druids' ritual is complete. The grove is closed now - perhaps for good.
We've interrupted the druids' ritual to close the grove, but now they are attacking the tieflings!
The grove is besieged by goblins! The druids will want nothing more to do with us.
We defeated the goblins. The refugees can safely leave the grove.

entries.name: Investigate the Beach
entries.description: We heard strange music on the beach. Where is it coming from?

objectives.title: Investigate the music.
journalEntries: We heard strange music on the beach. Where is it coming from?

objectives.title: Help the child.
journalEntries: We discovered a tiefling child in a strange trance.

objectives.title: Defeat the harpies.
journalEntries: Harpies appeared and attacked us.

objectives.title: Speak with the child.
journalEntries: We rescued the child from the harpies. He is alive and well.

objectives.title: Find Doni.
journalEntries: The child said we should pay a visit to Mol. We should tell a child named Doni that we want to see the 'Dragon's Lair'.

objectives.title: Find Mol.
journalEntries: Doni revealed a hatch and opened it for us - the 'Dragon's Lair' must be below.
Doni won't be able to show us how to get into the 'Dragon's Lair'. We'll need to find a way to Mol ourselves.
Doni disappeared somewhere. We'll need to find another way to get to Mol - or maybe Doni will be back eventually?
We know where Mol is hiding. Time to pay her a visit.

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: We found Mol. She was more than happy to meet us since we rescued one of her people.
Safe from the harpies, the child left the area.
The tiefling child died.
We weren't able to investigate the beach.
We heard strange music on the beach, but didn't investigate further.
We left the region without discovering what happened to the child.
We won't be having any conversations with Mol any time soon.
The situation has changed in the grove. Mol is busy dealing with other matters.

entries.name: Kill Kagha
entries.description: The tieflings and druids are at an impasse. Killing Kagha might tip the balance.

objectives.title: Kill Kagha
journalEntries: The tieflings and druids are at an impasse. Killing Kagha might tip the balance.
We exposed Kagha as a traitor. Furious, she attacked us.

objectives.title: Fight the druids.
journalEntries: We attacked Kagha, and the druids turned on all of the tieflings.

objectives.title: Return to Zevlor.
journalEntries: Kagha and the other druids are dead. The conflict in the grove has ended. We should check on the tieflings.
We killed Kagha and her Shadow Druid associates. Zevlor will be glad to hear it.

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: The goblins are marching on the grove. Kagha and Zevlor are too focused on their own people to worry about each other.
Zevlor thanked us for taking care of Kagha. Now we can focus on the goblin threat.
With Zevlor gone, there will be no reward for killing Kagha.
We persuaded Kagha to stop the ritual. The conflict has ended - the tieflings can stay in the grove.
With the road cleared, the tieflings can leave in peace.
Too many of the tieflings died. Unable to stay, the rest were forced from the grove.

entries.name: Raid the Emerald Grove
entries.description: Minthara is preparing to attack the grove and told us to wait for next light. We should get some rest.

objectives.title: Speak with Minthara.
journalEntries: Dror Ragzlin told us to speak to the drow Minthara. She plans to raid the adventurers' refuge - the grove.
The adventurer gave in and revealed the location of the grove. We have what the drow Minthara needs to order the raid.

objectives.title: Interrogate the prisoner.
journalEntries: Minthara asked us to interrogate the prisoner. She wants to know where the adventurers were hiding out.

objectives.title: Prepare to raid the Grove.
journalEntries: Minthara is preparing to attack the grove and told us to wait for next light. We should get some rest.
Sazza told the drow Minthara where the grove is. Minthara plans to raid it - and wants our help.

objectives.title: Secure the Emerald Grove.
journalEntries: Minthara and her warband have set out for the Grove. They are waiting for us to infiltrate it.

objectives.title: Report to the tiefling leader.
journalEntries: We arrived at the grove just in time. Minthara's raiders will be here soon.

objectives.title: Blow the horn.
journalEntries: The tieflings are as ready as they can be. All that's left is to sound the horn.

objectives.title: Defeat the raiders.
journalEntries: Minthara arrived with raiders by her side. Defeating them means safety at last for the tieflings.

objectives.title: Return to Zevlor/Asharak/Cerys.
journalEntries: The goblins were beaten back, and the tieflings lived to tell the tale. Zevlor/Asharak/Cerys wants to talk.

objectives.title: Slaughter the Emerald Grove.
journalEntries: We chose Minthara and the Absolute over the tieflings. Now to take the grove.
The tieflings are dead, but the druids are making a last stand at their sacred pool.

objectives.title: Return to Minthara.
journalEntries: Tieflings and druids alike lie dead. The grove belongs to the Absolute. Minthara will be pleased.
The grove was overrun before we could get involved. We should speak to Minthara.
Faced with a barricade of vines, the goblins couldn't raid the grove. Minthara isn't happy.

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: The goblin threat has ended, and the tieflings are ready to leave. Tonight, we celebrate our victory at camp.
With the tieflings dead, the grove is ours. Pleased, the Absolute granted us new powers. Tonight we celebrate at camp.
Minthara was furious that the grove was sealed and attacked us.
Minthara died before she could lead an attack on the grove.
Minthara died before she could reward us for our part in the attack on the grove.

entries.name: Return the Locket
entries.description: We met an adventurer called Barth who accused a tiefling child of stealing his locket. We suspected the child but couldn't get the locket back.

objectives.title: Retrieve the stolen locket.
journalEntries: We met an adventurer called Barth who accused a tiefling child of stealing his locket. We suspected the child but couldn't get the locket back.
An adventurer called Barth accused a tiefling child of stealing his locket. The adventurer was knocked out by a guard, and the child got away with the locket.

objectives.title: Return the stolen locket.
journalEntries: An adventurer called Barth accused a tiefling child of stealing his locket. Surprisingly, we found the locket on the child - Barth will want it back.
We found a locket stashed away - it's probably the same one Barth had stolen from him.
Unsurprisingly, we found the stolen locket in the child's pockets. Barth will want it back.

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: We returned the missing locket to Barth - free of charge.
Barth begrudgingly rewarded us for finding his locket.
We ignored Barth's protests and kept the locket.
Barth was killed before we could return his locket.
We never discovered what happened to the adventurer's locket - or whether the child was lying.
We weren't able to return the locket to the adventurer.

entries.name: Save Arabella
entries.description: We learned that a child named Arabella is being held by the druids on charges of theft. We should check on her.

objectives.title: Find Arabella.
journalEntries: We learned that a child named Arabella is being held by the druids on charges of theft. We should check on her.

objectives.title: Save Arabella.
journalEntries: We found Arabella in the druid's lair. She's being judged by Kagha, the leader of the druids, and is clearly in trouble.

objectives.title: Return to Arabella's Parents.
journalEntries: Intevene: "We managed to save Arabella, who immediately ran to her parents.
Arabella is safe - her parents are grateful for our intervention.
Do nothing: "Kagha's snake killed Arabella. Her parents should be informed.
Tell the truth: "We told Arabella's parents what happened. They were devastated.
Tell a lie: "We lied and told Arabella's parents that she was fine. They'll learn the bad news eventually - but not from us.

entries.name: Save the First Druid
entries.description: First Druid Halsin might be the only one capable of stopping Kagha from finishing the ritual. He was last seen on an expedition into goblin territory.

objectives.title: Search for Halsin in the Goblin Camp
journalEntries: The druid Halsin was last seen on an expedition into goblin territory.
The druid Rath told us that the First Druid Halsin might be the only one capable of stopping Kagha from finishing the ritual.
The adventurers were with Halsin when he disappeared. They might know what happened to him.
We learned that Halsin turned into a bear during the chaos of the failed expedition. He could still be disguised in that shape.
We learned that the goblins imprisoned the survivors deep within their camp. Halsin could be held captive there - if he survived.
We found a group of goblins massacred by some kind of animal. Could this have been the work of the missing druid Halsin?

objectives.title: Defeat the goblin leaders.
journalEntries: We saved a large bear who turned out to be a druid named Halsin. He asked us to kill the goblin leaders so he could restore peace to the grove.
We killed Dror Ragzlin, the goblin king.
The drow commander Minthara is dead.
We ended Priestess Gut's rituals - and her life.

objectives.title: Return to Halsin.
journalEntries: We defeated all three goblin leaders. We should report to Halsin.
The goblins left to attack the grove. We should report to Halsin.

objectives.title: Defend the Emerald Grove from the goblins.
journalEntries: The goblins have begun their raid on the grove. Halsin has gone there to fend them off - and hopefully mend the rift between the druids and tieflings.
We saved a large bear, and it ended up being the druid Halsin himself. He asked for help defeating the goblins before they destroy the grove.

objectives.title: Meet Halsin in the Emerald Grove.
journalEntries: We helped Halsin save the grove. Hopefully, he can resolve the conflict between the tieflings and the druids. We'll find out when we meet him there.
Halsin has returned to the grove. We should speak to him.
A large bear we saved turned out to be a druid named Halsin. He told us to meet him back at the grove.
The large bear we saved was actually the missing druid Halsin. He told us to meet him back at the grove.

objectives.title: Speak with Rath.
journalEntries: Halsin thanked us and said that Rath would surely reward us for our efforts.

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: Halsin was defeated.
Rath was grateful and pointed us to a hidden vault locked by runes in the Enclave Library.
The tieflings left for Baldur's Gate - the grove will be at peace now. Rath should have something for us.
The tieflings left for Baldur's Gate - the grove will be at peace now.
The grove was sealed before we could find Halsin. He won't be needed at the grove anymore.
The tieflings and the druids were defeated. The grove has been destroyed.
Rath thanked us for saving the grove.
Rath is dead.
Halsin thanked us for saving him.
The surviving tieflings have left, and we haven't found Halsin. The grove would likely still benefit from his return.

entries.name: Save the Goblin Sazza
entries.description: The goblin Sazza is a prisoner in the grove. She's promise us an introduction to her tribe and their powerful healer - if we break her out.

objectives.title: Free Sazza.
journalEntries: The goblin Sazza is a prisoner in the grove. She's promised us an introduction to her tribe - and their powerful healer - if we break her out.

objectives.title: Escort Sazza out of the Emerald Grove.
journalEntries: We broke Sazza out. Now for the hard part - getting her out of the grove.

objectives.title: Reach the Goblin Camp.
journalEntries: We got out of the grove in one piece. Sazza told us to meet her at the Goblin Camp.

objectives.title: Speak to Sazza and the drow.
journalEntries: Thanks to Sazza, we made it to the camp. She told us to meet her further inside, where she'll introduce us to the drow True Soul.
We found Sazza talking to the drow. She still owes us information - maybe this drow has it?

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: Sazza died.
Sazza died while trying to escape the grove.
We didn't free Sazza. Who knows what happened to her?
We rescued Sazza but didn't get the information she promised.
We never met Sazza at the Goblin Camp.
Sazza was thrown into the spider pit and eaten alive.
Once again, we saved Sazza. She owes us - big time.
Sazza betrayed us, but we convinced Minthara to spare her life. Let's hope she'll remember what we did for her.

entries.name: Save the Refugees
entries.description: Kagha, the leader of the druids, ordered the tiefling to leave the grove. Zevlor fears they won't survive on the road and asked us to intervene.

objectives.title: Travel to the Emerald Grove.
journalEntries: The goblins are planning to attack the grove. We should return there as soon as possible.

objectives.title: Help the Grove.
journalEntries: Rath believes that Halsin is the only one able to persuade Kagha to stop the ritual - and save the tieflings.
Wyll wants to defeat the Goblin leaders to give the tieflings a chance once they're back on the road.

objectives.title: Meet with Kagha.
journalEntries: Kagha, leader of the druids, wants to speak with us.

objectives.title: Speak with Kagha.
journalEntries: Kagha, the leader of the druids, ordered the tiefling to leave the grove. Zevlor fears they won't survive on the road and asked us to intervene.

objectives.title: Return to Zevlor.
journalEntries: Kagha wants the tieflings gone. She asked us to guide them out of the grove.
Kagha wants us to make the tiefling leave - she fears the grove cannot support both them and itself.
We found a note involving Kagha. Something is going on in the grove. We should get to the bottom of it.

objectives.title: End the conflict.
journalEntries: We found a mysterious note addressed to Kagha. We should investigate further.
We found an interesting note involving Kagha. It might help us resolve the conflict in the grove.
Kagha plans to seal the grove shut, while Zevlor won't leave until the roads are safe. We need to resolve this.
Zevlor died, but the tieflings still need our help.

objectives.title: Help the tieflings leave.
journalEntries: The tieflings are safe - for now. But they still need to reach Baldur's Gate. That can't happen until the roads are safe from goblins.
Kagha died before the tieflings were forced out of the grove.
Zevlor died, but Kagha still plans to seal the grove shut. If we want the tieflings to survive, we need to clear the roads of goblins before the ritual is completed.

objectives.title: Report to the tiefling leader.
journalEntries: The goblins are about to attack the grove. If we want to save the tieflings, we need to get back to the grove to protect it - and fast.

objectives.title: Destroy the Emerald Grove.
journalEntries: We decided to help the goblins burn down the grove - along with anyone opposing the will of the Absolute.

objectives.title: Talk to Zevlor.
journalEntries: With the goblins defeated, the tieflings can safely return to the road. They will be happy to learn the news.

objectives.title: Celebrate at Camp.
journalEntries: Grateful for our help, the tieflings are celebrating our victory. Time to have some fun.

objectives.title: Quest Completed!
journalEntries: Instead of helping them, we betrayed the tieflings for the Absolute. None of them survived.

entries.name: Steal the Sacred Idol
entries.description: Mol asked us to steal some kind of idol from the druids.

objectives.title: Steal the druids' sacred idol.
journalEntries: Mol asked us to steal some kind of idol from the druids.

objectives.title: Fight the druids.
journalEntries: We took the sacred idol and disrupted the ritual - but now the druids are attacking the tieflings.

objectives.title: Give the Idol of Silvanus to Mol.
journalEntries: Mol asked us to steal a sacred idol from the druids. Luckily, we already have it.
We stole the sacred idol and killed all the druids. Now we just need to deliver the idol to Mol.
Even though the ritual to seal the grove had been halted, we stole the sacred idol. Now to deliver it to Mol.

objectives.title: Find Mol in Baldur's Gate.
journalEntries: We gave the sacred idol to Mol. She promised to repay us in Baldur's Gate.
Mol and her crew left for Baldur's Gate before we could speak with her. We should look for her in the city.

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: We gave the sacred idol to Mol. She promised to repay us in Baldur's Gate.
We angered Mol and her gang - they won't deal with us anymore.
We decided to keep the sacred idol for ourselves.
The tieflings were forced out of the grove before we could steal the sacred idol.
We left the grove without stealing the sacred idol.
We weren't able to return the idol to Mol.

entries.name: Destroy the Ancient Tome
entries.description: Evil is inscribed on every page of this book. But all evil has a weakness - there must be a way to destroy it.

objectives.title: Destroy the book.
journalEntries: Evil is inscribed on every page of this book. But all evil has a weakness - there must be a way to destroy it.
Only light from the divine can burn away this book's evil.

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: The book has been destroyed, along with any dark secrets it contained. Good riddance.
The book was too valuable to be destroyed - we decided to take its knowledge for ourselves.
The book was lost, along with any dark secrets it contained.

entries.name: Finish the Masterwork Weapon
entries.description: We found blueprints for masterwork weapons. All we need to forge one is some bark from a Sussur Tree.

objectives.title: Find the blueprints.
journalEntries: We found the journal of a blacksmith's apprentice. It mentioned blueprints to create masterwork weapons. They must be nearby.

objectives.title: Find a Sussur Tree.
journalEntries: We found blueprints for masterwork weapons. All we need to forge one is some bark from a Sussur Tree.
We found the blueprints the journal mentioned. If we find some bark from a sussur tree, we could forge a masterwork weapon.

objectives.title: Take some bark from the Sussur Tree.
journalEntries: We found a Sussur Tree. Now we need to take some of its bark.

objectives.title: Forge a weapon.
journalEntries: We've got the Sussur Bark - now we need to head back to the forge.

objectives.title: Quest Completed!
journalEntries: We forged a masterwork dagger/sickle/greatsword.

entries.name: Rescue the Gnome
entries.description: We spotted a deep gnome tied to the blades of a windmill. He's being tormented by a group of goblins.

objectives.title: Approach the goblins.
journalEntries: We spotted a deep gnome tied to the blades of a windmill. He's being tormented by a group of goblins.

objectives.title: Defeat the goblins.
journalEntries: The goblins attacked us.

objectives.title: Stop the windmill.
journalEntries: We've defeated the goblins. If we want to help the gnome, we'll have to stop the windmill.
It took some convincing, but the goblins left. If we want to help the gnome, we'll have to stop the windmill. (70 XP Rewarded)

objectives.title: Untie the gnome.
journalEntries: Now that the windmill has stopped spinning, we should be able to untie the gnome. (15 XP Rewarded)

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: After rescuing Barcus Wroot, we parted ways with him.
We invited Barcus Wroot to our camp.
The deep gnome was killed.
We left without helping the deep gnome.

entries.name: Search the Cellar
entries.description: We found a journal that mentioned a cellar - along with some powerful items. This sounds promising and, more importantly, valuable.

objectives.title: Find the cellar.
journalEntries: We found a journal that mentioned a cellar - along with some powerful items. This sounds promising and, more importantly, valuable.
We found an apothecary's ledger. It mentions some rare plants stored in a cellar - could be worth finding.

objectives.title: Investigate the cellar.
journalEntries: We found the cellar mentioned by the journal. Time to have a look around.

objectives.title: Find the necromancer's book.
journalEntries: The owner of the cellar was more than a doctor - he was a necromancer. And he was obsessed with a particular book.

objectives.title: Decide what to do with the book of necromancy.
journalEntries: We found a strange and powerful tome, 'The Necromancy of Thay'. What should we do with it?
Books like these contain manifold secrets - though they've been known to drive people mad.

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: We deciphered the final page of 'The Necromancy of Thay', and finished the book.
The book was destroyed, along with any secrets it had.
The book was lost, along with its secrets.
The 'Tharchiate Codex', key to finishing 'The Necromancy of Thay', was destroyed.

entries.name: Unlock the Ancient Tome
entries.description: This book is locked tight, and the mechanism isn't shaped for a key. Maybe some kind of stone would work?

objectives.title: Unlock the book.
journalEntries: This book is locked tight, and the mechanism isn't shaped for a key. Maybe some kind of stone would work?
The owner of the tome mentioned a keygem. Could this be the secret to unlocking The Necromancy of Thay?
The necromancer's apprentice mentioned a keygem lost in the tunnels. We need to find it.
We found the gem to unlock the book.

objectives.title: Read the book.
journalEntries: We've unlocked the book of necromancy. Should we read it?
The tome is clearly powerful, but we'll need to read further to uncover all of its secrets.

objectives.title: Find a way to finish The Necromancy of Thay.
journalEntries: We managed to read most of the book, absorbing some of it's necromatic power, but it snapped shut before we could finish. There must be a way to read the end.
We made it to the final page of the tome, but it's indecipherable. We need to find a way to read it.
Mystic Carrion and his spirits told us that we need the Tharchiate Codex to unlock the true power of The Necromancy of Thay.

objectives.title: Find the Tharchiate Codex in Sorcerous Sundries.
journalEntries: Mystic Carrion and his spirits told us that we need the Tharchiate Codex to unlock the true power of The Necromancy of Thay. We can find it in the Sorcerous Sundries.
We spoke to Tolna, the bookseller in Sorcerous Sundries. She said that rare books, such as the Tharchiate Codex, are not for sale. Instead, they are kept in a secure vault.

objectives.title: Enter the vault.
journalEntries: The entrance to the vault, where we can find the Tharchaite Codex, is in Tolna's office.

objectives.title: Find the Tharchiate Codex.
journalEntries: We've accessed the vault, and the lower level of Sorcerous Sundries. Now to find the Tharchiate Codex.

objectives.title: Read the Tharchiate Codex.
journalEntries: We have the Tharchiate Codex. To decipher The Necromancy of Thay, we need to first read the codex.

objectives.title: Master The Necromancy of Thay.
journalEntries: We read the Tharchiate Codex, and now have the knowledge to finish The Necromancy of Thay

objectives.title: Quest Completed!
journalEntries: We deciphered the final page of The Necromancy of Thay. The power to summon powerful Thayan undead is ours.

entries.name: Get Help from Auntie Ethel
entries.description: We met an eccentric old lady in the Emerald Grove. She's confident she can remove our parasites and invited us to her teahouse.

objectives.title: Get Auntie Ethel's help.
journalEntries: We met an eccentric old lady in the Emerald Grove. She's confident she can remove our parasites and invited us to her teahouse.
We met an eccentric old lady at a teahouse in the wilderness. She's confident she can remove our parasites - for a price.
Ethel named her price for helping us: one of our eyes.
We agreed to give up an eye in exchange for removing the parasite.

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: We made a deal with Auntie Ethel, but she couldn't remove the parasite, claiming it was Netherese. If a green hag can't help us, who can?
Auntie Ethel died before she could help us. We need to find someone else to remove the parasite.
Things turned violent with Auntie Ethel. She isn't happy with us.
We left the area before finding out whether the old lady could help us.

entries.name: Save Mayrina
entries.description: Two brothers said that their sister Mayrina is being held against her will at Ethel's house - something the old woman denied.

objectives.title: Question Auntie Ethel.
journalEntries: Two brothers said that their sister Mayrina is being held against her will at Ethel's house - something the old woman denied.
After Auntie Ethel vanished, two brothers set off after her - determined to find their sister Mayrina. Something isn't right here.
We found the two brothers dead. They clearly died in pain.
We discovered a distressed pregnant woman in the company of Auntie Ethel. What is she doing here?
We met Mayrina and Auntie Ethel at the teahouse. There is something strange about their relationship.
When we told Mayrina her brothers were dead, she was devastated. Ethel wasn't very pleased either.
We saw through the illusion that hid the area, revealing a stinking, nightmarish place.

objectives.title: Rescue Mayrina.
journalEntries: Auntie Ethel waved her hand and Mayrina vanished. What happened to her?
Auntie Ethel, the Green Hag, disappeared through her fireplace. If we follow her, perhaps we'll find Mayrina.
The fireplace revealed a hidden passage under Auntie Ethel's home - leading to a dark, twisted lair.

objectives.title: Defeat the Hag.
journalEntries: We found Auntie Ethel in the heart of her lair. She is furious with us. We're in for a fight.

objectives.title: Speak with Mayrina.
journalEntries: We persuaded Auntie Ethel to both give us the great power and release Mayrina.
We made a deal with the hag. We let her live in exchange for Mayrina's life.
Auntie Ethel is finally dead. We should see if Mayrina is all right.

objectives.title: Search the lair for a way to help Mayrina.
journalEntries: We saved Mayrina, but she was in a bad way. She left to say goodbye to her husband at his grave - perhaps we can help her somehow?

objectives.title: Bring the wand to Mayrina.
journalEntries: We found a wand with Connor's name on it. Could this resurrect Mayrina's husband?

objectives.title: Decide Connor's fate.
journalEntries: With our help, Mayrina's husband was resurrected - but Connor is a broken shell of who he once was. Would it be right to keep him alive like this?

objectives.title: Slay Connor.
journalEntries: The creature that was once Mayrina's husband is an abomination. We have no choice but to destroy it.

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: We made a deal with Auntie Ethel for great power. She left - and took Mayrina with her.
Mayrina's husband died at our hands.
Mayrina is dead.
We killed Mayrina.
We decided to keep Mayrina's husband for ourselves. Distraught, Mayrina left.
Determined to find a cure, Mayrina and Connor left for Baldur's Gate. Who knows if we'll ever see them again?
We destroyed the wand that could bring Mayrina's husband back to life. She was distraught.
We knocked Mayrina out.
We left before we could save the unfortunate Mayrina

entries.name: Find the Missing Shipment
entries.description: Zarys, leader of the local Zhentarim, said her agents went missing while transporting a shipment. She'll pay a hefty sum if we return it unopened.

objectives.title: Find the missing wagon.
journalEntries: Zarys, leader of the local Zhentarim, said her agents went missing while transporting a shipment. She'll pay a hefty sum if we return it unopened.

objectives.title: Search for survivors of the caravan.
journalEntries: We found the remains of a caravan. A note on a corpse mentioned a valuable chest and someone called 'NF'. Perhaps someone survived this attack.
We discovered the wrecked wagon and a note on one of the dead. This must be one of Zarys' missing agents, but where are the others? And the shipment?
We discovered a wrecked wagon. A corpse told us that someone called Rugan escaped with a chest and headed north. We should search for him.

objectives.title: Help the trapped survivors.
journalEntries: We found Zarys' missing agents trapped in a cave surrounded by gnolls. If we want to save them, we'll have to take out the gnolls first.
We discovered two people trapped in a cave, surrounded by a horde of ravenous gnolls. They'll likely die without help.

objectives.title: Check on the survivors.
journalEntries: Using our parasite, we forced the gnoll leader to attack the men in the cave. It's sure to be a bloodbath.

objectives.title: Speak with Rugan/Olly.
journalEntries: The gnolls have been defeated. We should let Rugan/Olly know.

objectives.title: Defeat the survivors.
journalEntries: Things turned sour with the survivors in the cave. We'll make quick work of them.

objectives.title: Take the shipment.
journalEntries: Zarys' agents lie dead. We need to bring their shipment back to Zarys.
The two men died. Their cargo is still in the cave, however. It looks valuable.
One of Zarys' agents is dead. Olly wants nothing to do with the chest they carried. Zarys will want it back.
The shipment is ours. We should grab it while we can - and decide what to do with it.

objectives.title: Meet with Rugan's associates.
journalEntries: Rugan thanked us and invited us to meet his associates. To enter their hideout, we need to use the password 'little serpent, long shadow'.
We learned that, to enter the Zhentarim hideout, we need to use the password 'little serpent, long shadow'.
We spoke to Rugan's body and learned of a Zhentarim hideout nearby, beneath a tavern. We should go there.

objectives.title: Return to Zarys.
journalEntries: Zarys' agents died. However, we have the shipment. She'll be pleased.
Rugan thanked us for saving him and the other agent. We should return to Zarys for payment.
One of Zarys' agents lies dead, but we have the shipment. Zarys will be pleased.

objectives.title: Speak with the Zhentarim leader.
journalEntries: We were able to successfully enter the hideout. Time to find who's in charge.

objectives.title: Decide what to do with the chest.
journalEntries: The two men died, but left behind a valuable chest. We could try to find its owner, or just open it and take what's inside.
We took a locked and sealed chest from Rugan, one of the men we saved from gnolls. The chest is now ours, but we could try to find its owner.
The men hiding from the gnolls were carrying a locked, sealed chest. We could try to find its owner, or just open it and take what's inside.

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: Pleased, Zarys rewarded us for defending her agents and bringing back the shipment.
We made enemies of the Zhentarim before we could complete our mission.
We left before fully investigating the shipment and its owners.
Pleased, Zarys rewarded us for bringing back the shipment.
Zarys attacked us when she learned we had lost the chest. We should have been more careful.
We broke the seal on the chest. No point in returning it to the owner now - guess it's ours!
We kept the chest and left the area with it.
We tried meeting with Rugan's associates but were refused entry.
We tried to return the chest, but things went wrong. Guess it's ours now.
Pleased, Zarys rewarded us for defending her agents. We kept quiet about the shipment.
We joined the Zhentarim. Zarys needs us to bring the shipment to Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Free the Artist
entries.description: We met Oskar, an artist captured by the Zhentarim. He begged us to help him escape, promising that his patron will reward us handsomely.

objectives.title: Help Oskar escape.
journalEntries: We met Oskar, an artist captured by the Zhentarim. He begged us to help him escape, promising that his patron will reward us handsomely.
We told Oskar we'd rescue him. Now to figure out how.
Brem agreed to sell us Oskar for a hefty sum of gold.
It took some convincing, but we got Brem to lower the price.
We bought Oskar from Zhentarium. We should tell him the good news.
We persuaded the Zhentarim that Oskar was more trouble than he was worth. They let him go.
Oskar told us his story. Caught up in a romantic scandal with a patriar of Baldur's Gate, he fled his engagement to her.

objectives.title: Look for Oskar in Baldur's Gate.
journalEntries: Oskar left for Baldur's Gate. Who knows, maybe we'll see him there.

objectives.title: Check up on Lady Jannath.
journalEntries: Lady Jannath's butler, Tarhun, indicated to us that something very strange is going on and was clearly unsettled. We should investigate.

objectives.title: Find out what's haunting the Jannath Estate.
journalEntries: The Jannath Estate is clearly haunted. We should find what's causing this.

objectives.title: Incapacitate Oskar.
journalEntries: We found Oskar, who is possessed and aggressive. His wife, Lady Jannath, has asked us to incapacitate him.

objectives.title: Explore the Jannath Estate.
journalEntries: We knocked out Oskar, but he is still possessed. Maybe there are clues around the mansion that will help us find out what caused this.

objectives.title: Investigate the Atelier in the Jannath Estate.
journalEntries: Lady Jannath said that since the wedding, Oskar has been working obsessively up in his Atelier. We should go investigate.
We briefly broke the enchantment possessing Oskar. During those brief moments, he mentioned the Atelier. We might find more clues there.
We found the Atelier. There must be something in here that will point us toward the source of Oskar's possession.
We discovered a secret room in the Atelier.

The hidden portrait of the maiden seems to be invulnerable to normal attacks and responds to violence with violence. There must be some way of coaxing out whatever's tormenting it. We should look around for clues.

objectives.title: Ask Lady Jannath about Mystic Carrion.
journalEntries: We found a letter from a Mystic Carrion addressed to Oskar. It says to bring the letter to Carrion's mansion and provides a password that will grant entry. We might want to ask Lady Jannath if she knows anything about this mystic.

objectives.title: Find Mystic Carrion's mansion.
journalEntries: We found a letter from a Mystic Carrion addressed to Oskar. It says to bring the letter to Carrion's mansion and provides a password that will grant entry. We should find where he lives and ask him about Oskar.

objectives.title: Talk to Mystic Carrion about Oskar.
journalEntries: We spoke to Lady Jannath about Mystic Carrion. She said that Carrion's services are a fad amongst the nobility and that we can find his mansion down near the water. We should go speak to him.

We found a letter from a Mystic Carrion addressed to Oskar. It says to bring the letter to Carrion's mansion and provides a password that will grant entry. We should pay him a visit and ask him about Oskar.

objectives.title: Help Mystic Carrion in exchange for the means to exorcise the spirit from Oskar.
journalEntries: Carrion revealed that Oskar came to him to talk to a tormented spirit. He's willing to help us exorcise this spirit from Oskar if we help him with his missing servant first.
Carrion revealed that Oskar came to him to talk to a tormented spirit. He's willing to give us a Torch of Revocation to exorcise the spirit from Oskar if we help him with his missing servant first.
We convinced Lady Jannath to help us pay Mystic Carrion for Oskar's cure.

objectives.title: Explore Mystic Carrion's mansion.
journalEntries: We made an enemy of Mystic Carrion before learning how to exorcise the spirit possessing Oskar. We'll have to search Carrion's mansion for clues.
We found a stash of client information. Maybe it will contain clues about how to exorcise the spirit possessing Oskar.

objectives.title: Obtain the Torch of Revocation.
journalEntries: We made an enemy of Carrion, so we'll have to find the Torch of Revocation ourselves. It must be around here somewhere.
We found Oskar on a list of Mystic Carrion's clients. It revealed that a Torch of Revocation can be used to destroy the cursed portrait. We need to find one.

objectives.title: Destroy the cursed portrait in the Jannath Estate.
journalEntries: We got our hands on the Torch of Revocation. We should use it to destroy the cursed portrait in the Jannath Estate.

objectives.title: Confront the spirit of Kerri Evenfield.
journalEntries: We successfully destroyed the cursed portrait, forcing the spirit out. She went looking for Oskar. We should follow her.

objectives.title: Find Oskar in the Atelier to receive a reward.
journalEntries: We convinced Kerri's spirit to leave this plane. Lady Jannath and Oskar made amends. We should find Oskar up in the Atelier to receive the reward we were promised.
We defeated Kerri's spirit, but Lady Jannath couldn't forgive Oskar and they parted ways. We should find Oskar up in the Atelier and ask for the reward we were promised.
We defeated Kerri's spirit and convinced Lady Jannath to give Oskar another chance. We should find Oskar up in the Atelier and ask for the reward we were promised.

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: Oskar died.
We called Oskar our slave after freeing him from the Zhentarim, which led to a sour goodbye.
We left Oskar with the Zhentarim.
We left Oskar to his fate, consumed by the spirit possessing him.
We killed Oskar. At least the spirit possessing him will be free.
We let Kerri's spirit kill Oskar. Once the deed was done, she vanished.
We convinced Kerri's spirit to leave this plane. However, Oskar was devastated to learn that his wife was dead, so he wasn't ready to paint us. He gave us his sketchbook as payment instead.
We defeated Kerri's spirit, but Oskar was devastated to learn that his wife was dead. He wasn't ready to paint us, so he gave us his sketchbook as payment.
Oskar painted a portrait of us and gifted it to us as thanks for our troubles.
We left Oskar to his fate after finding him possessed by a spirit.
We abandoned Oskar during the fight with Kerri's spirit.

entries.name: Hunt the Devil
entries.description: We met a group of paladins of Tyr who are hunting a devil. Anders asked for our help - we agreed to search for the devil.

objectives.title: Find the devil.
journalEntries: We spoke to a corpse who claimed to be an infernal servant of the devil Zariel. What business does a devil have here?
We met a group of paladins of Tyr who are hunting a devil. Anders asked for our help - we agreed to search for the devil.

objectives.title: Kill the tiefling.
journalEntries: We met a tiefling who matches the devil's description. Now's our chance.
The devil is actually a tiefling called Karlach. She told us that the paladins are actually servants of the archdevil Zariel who were sent to hunt her down.

objectives.title: Confront the paladins.
journalEntries: We decided to let Karlach join us. The 'paladins' will have something to say about it.
Karlach joined us. She told us she's being hunted by servants of Zariel who are pretending to be Paladins of Tyr. We need to deal with them.

objectives.title: Take Karlach's head.
journalEntries: The devil is dead. Time to take her head.

objectives.title: Deliver Karlach's head.
journalEntries: We have the devil's head. We should take it back to Anders.

objectives.title: Kill Karlach.
journalEntries: We betrayed Karlach.

objectives.title: Speak to Anders.
journalEntries: We killed Karlach. Anders will have something to say about that.

objectives.title: Kill Zariel's followers.
journalEntries: Zariel's followers want to kill Karlach. We need to protect her.

objectives.title: Quest Complete!
journalEntries: Anders rewarded us for our help.
We defeated Anders.
Anders thanked us for our help.
We left the area without helping the paladins of Tyr.
We defeated Zariel's followers. Karlach is safe - for now.

entries.name: Rescue the Grand Duke
entries.description: We approached a burning inn called Waukeen's Rest. Flaming Fists are trying to break down the door - a Grand Duke of Baldur's Gate is trapped inside.

objectives.title: Find a way into Waukeen's Rest.
journalEntries: We approached a burning inn called Waukeen's Rest. Flaming Fists are trying to break down the door - a Grand Duke of Baldur's Gate is trapped inside.
We couldn't get through the door. There must be another way in.

objectives.title: Search for survivors.
journalEntries: We managed to get inside. We need to find the Grand Duke and fast.
We found a survivor trapped behind a locked door.
A man is stuck under some rubble. He's not the Grand Duke, but he still needs help.

objectives.title: Speak with Counsellor Florrick.
journalEntries: The woman we rescued survived. Maybe she saw the Grand Duke?

objectives.title: Search for Grand Duke Ravengard.
journalEntries: We learned that the Grand Duke of Baldur's Gate was kidnapped.
We learned that the Grand Duke was captured by drow and taken westwards.
We agreed to look for the Grand Duke. We should investigate the area.
Moonrise Towers is a popular location - at least for the cult of the Absolute. Perhaps the Grand Duke was taken there too.
We agreed to look for the Grand Duke. We should head to Moonrise Towers.
We learned nothing from the woman we rescued. Someone else must know what happened to the Grand Duke.
We refused to help Counsellor Florrick. But we should keep an eye out for the Grand Duke - he'd make a powerful ally.
We didn't find the Grand Duke or anyone who'd seen him. We should still keep an eye out, though - he'd make a powerful ally.
We met Counsellor Florrick at Last Light Inn. She urged us to search for Grand Duke Ravengard. She believes he is being held in Moonrise Towers.
We finally reached Moonrise Towers. Grand Duke Ravengard must be here somewhere.
We finally found Grand Duke Ravengard - standing by Gortash's side as he crowned Gortash the new Archduke. He disappeared after the ceremony.

Wyll severed his pact with Mizora, even after she hinted that she could help locate and rescue Grand Duke Ravengard. It would seem the duke is as good as dead, but perhaps we might still find and save him.
We reached Gortash's underwater command centre, also known as the Iron Throne. We need to find Grand Duke Ravengard.

objectives.title: Pursue Ravengard's captors to Baldur's Gate.
journalEntries: Grand Duke Ravengard was infected with an illithid tadpole, and taken to Baldur's Gate.

objectives.title: Talk to Mizora.
journalEntries: Grand Duke Ravengard is dead. Wyll's patron, Mizora, awaits us in camp. Perhaps she can help.

objectives.title: Rest at camp.
journalEntries: Mizora asked us to meet her in camp. She has an important proposal to make regarding Wyll's father, Grand Duke Ravengard.

objectives.title: Find the secret command centre.
journalEntries: Wyll made a pact with Mizora and the archdevil Zariel in exchange for information about Grand Duke Ravengard's whereabouts. He is being held prisoner at Gortash's secret command centre.

objectives.title: Lead Grand Duke Ravengard to safety.
journalEntries: We found Grand Duke Ravengard. We need to lead him to safety.

objectives.title: Speak to Grand Duke Ravengard.
journalEntries: Grand Duke Ravengard is safe at last. We should speak to him at our camp.
In exchange for an eternal pact with Wyll, Mizora resurrected Grand Duke Ravengard. We should speak with him.

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: Grand Duke Ravengard is dead.
Grand Duke Ravengard is safe, and grateful for our help.
Grand Duke Ravengard has been brought back from the dead and is free from the Absolute's influence, thanks to the Emperor. He will make a formidable ally when the time comes to face the elder brain.
Wyll broke his pact with Mizora, even after she offered to resurrect his father. Grand Duke Ulder Ravengard is no more.
Wyll broke his pact with Mizora. Duke Ravengard is no longer our concern.

entries.name: Rescue the Trapped Man
entries.description: We found a man trapped under a beam in Waukeen's Rest.

objectives.title: Free the Trapped Man.
journalEntries: We found a man trapped under a beam in Waukeen's Rest.

objectives.title: Get Benryn to safety.
journalEntries: We freed Benryn and promised to guide him out of the tavern.

objectives.title: Speak with Benryn.
journalEntries: Benryn got out of the tavern safely.
Benryn was faced with the dead body of his wife. He must be devastated.

objectives.title: Find Miri.
journalEntries: Benryn is searching for his wife Miri. She has brown hair and was wearing a green blouse.

objectives.title: Tell Benryn where Miri is.
journalEntries: We found a dead woman that matches Miri's description.

objectives.title: Find the dowry.
journalEntries: Miri told us about her sister's dowry, which she hid before the fire started. It's in a barn somewhere near the tavern.
Benryn mentioned a dowry for him and his wife. It's worth searching for it.

objectives.title: Return to Benryn.
journalEntries: The dowry turned out to be a ring. It's probably worth a tidy sum. Benryn will want it back.

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: We returned the ring to Benryn.
We decided to keep the ring. Benryn was furious.
Benryn died.
Benryn is beyond our help.
We left before we could tie up loose ends with Benryn. We must press on.

entries.name: Ask the Goblin Priestess for Help
entries.description: We learned that a goblin tribe is led by a priestess with powerful magic. Dealing with goblins is risky, but this might be one way to cure ourselves.
entries.wikiTitle: Ask the Goblin Priestess for Help
entries.section: Act One / Goblin Camp and Shattered Sanctum

objectives.title: Find the goblin priestess.
journalEntries: We learned that a goblin tribe is led by a priestess with powerful magic. Dealing with goblins is risky, but this might be one way to cure ourselves.

objectives.title: Follow Priestess Gut.
journalEntries: We decided to trust Priestess Gut. If we follow her to her chapel, she'll examine the parasite.

objectives.title: Drink Priestess Gut's potion.
journalEntries: Now that we have some privacy, Priestess Gut is prepared to assist us. All we need to do is drink a potion.

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: We were drugged and imprisoned by Priestess Gut. She hopes that we'll turn into mind flayers so she can study us. We need to get out of here - now.
Priestess Gut might have been able to help us, but being a goblin proved to be fatal for her. We'll need to find another way to remove the parasite.
We've been marked as enemies of the Absolute - there's no way Priestess Gut will help us now.
We repelled Priestess Gut's mental probe. Not capable of understanding what ailed us, she told us she couldn't help.
We left the area without seeing if the goblin priestess could heal us.

entries.name: Defeat the Goblins
entries.description: If the tieflings are to make their way to Baldur's Gate, we will need to deal with the goblins. Zevlor thinks someone must be organising them. We should investigate their camp.
entries.section: Act One / Goblin Camp and Shattered Sanctum

objectives.title: Travel to the Goblin Camp.
journalEntries: If the tieflings are to make their way to Baldur's Gate, we will need to deal with the goblins. Zevlor thinks someone must be organising them. We should investigate their camp.
There were three figures in the drawing we found. The goblins must have more than one leader.

objectives.title: Find the leader of the Goblin Camp.
journalEntries: Travel to the Goblin Camp.
We arrived at the Goblin Camp. Now we need to find who's in charge and deal with them.

objectives.title: Search for the leaders.
journalEntries: We learned that there are three people in charge, but we need more information.
We've arrived in the Goblin Camp. Now to find the three leaders.
We've killed the goblin king, a hobgoblin named Dror Ragzlin. The goblins are still celebrating, though - there must be more leaders.
We killed Minthara, the drow commander. But she can't have been the only one keeping the goblins in line - we need to find more leaders.
We killed the goblins' spiritual leader, Priestess Gut. Someone else must have led them into battle - we need to find them.
The goblins' spiritual leader, Priestess Gut, was defeated. Someone else must have led them into battle - we need to find them.

objectives.title: Kill all three leaders.
journalEntries: There are three leaders of the Goblin Camp: Dror Ragzlin, Priestess Gut, and a drow.
The drow is called Minthara. With this, we can cripple the goblins.
There are three leaders of the Goblin Camp: Dror Ragzlin, Priestess Gut, and the drow Minthara.
We killed the goblin king Dror Ragzlin.
We killed one of the goblin leaders, a drow named Minthara.
A drow named Minthara, one of the goblin leaders, was defeated.
We killed Priestess Gut, one of the goblin leaders.

objectives.title: Speak with Zevlor.
journalEntries: With Dror Ragzlin dead, the goblins have no leadership. They won't be a threat now - we should tell the tieflings.
With Dror Ragzlin defeated, the goblins have no leadership. They won't be a threat now - we should tell the tieflings.
With Minthara dead, the goblins have no leadership. They won't be a threat now - we should tell the tieflings.
With Minthara defeated, the goblins have no leadership. They won't be a threat now - we should tell the tieflings.
With Priestess Gut dead, the goblins have no leadership. They won't be a threat now - we should tell the tieflings.

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: The roads are safe, and the tieflings are ready to leave. Tonight, we celebrate at camp.
Killing the goblin leaders no longer matters. Minthara left with her band of raiders, and they're going to attack the grove.
The tieflings were forced out of the grove before we could deal with the goblins. They'll likely die on the road.

entries.name: Rescue the Druid Halsin
entries.description: Halsin was actively researching the parasite - he might be one of the few people who understand our condition.
entries.section: Act One / Goblin Camp and Shattered Sanctum

objectives.title: Find the druid Halsin.
journalEntries: Halsin was last seen leaving the grove with a group of adventurers.
Halsin was actively researching the parasite - he might be one of the few people who understand our condition.

objectives.title: Search for Halsin in the Goblin Camp
journalEntries: We learned that a powerful druid named Halsin hasn't returned from an expedition into goblin territory. He might be able to help us.
The druid Halsin was researching the parasite. He might be one of the few people who understands our condition - we need to find him.
Halsin's research suggests that the parasite is connected to a Goblin Camp located in an old temple of Selûne.
The adventurers were with Halsin when he disappeared. They might know what happened to him.
We learned that Halsin transformed into a bear during the chaos of the failed expedition. He might still be in that shape.
We learned that the goblins imprisoned the survivors deep within their camp. Halsin could be held captive there - if he survived.
We discovered that the druid Halsin was here in the Goblin Camp and he claimed to be able to remove their parasites. If he's still alive, he might be able to help us.
Aradin told us the druid Halsin was either killed or captured by the goblins. The only way to find out for sure is to infiltrate their camp.
We found a group of goblins massacred by some kind of animal. Could this have been the work of the missing druid Halsin?

objectives.title: Defeat the goblin leaders.
journalEntries: We found the missing druid Halsin. He can't heal us, but if we help him defeat the goblin leaders, he may help us find answers at Moonrise Towers.
We killed Dror Ragzlin, the goblin king.
The drow commander Minthara is dead.
We killed Priestess Gut, the goblin priestess.

objectives.title: Return to Halsin.
journalEntries: We defeated all three goblin leaders. We should report to Halsin.
The goblins left to attack the grove. We should report to Halsin.

objectives.title: Defend the Emerald Grove from the goblins.
journalEntries: We found the missing druid Halsin. He can't heal us, but if we help defend the grove from the goblins, he may help us find answers at Moonrise Towers.
Halsin has left to fend off the goblins attacking the grove. If the defences hold, we can find him there afterwards.

objectives.title: Meet Halsin in the Emerald Grove.
journalEntries: With the goblin leaders dead, Halsin and the grove can rest easy. We should meet him there to discuss what comes next.
With the raiders dead, Halsin and the grove can rest easy. We should meet him there to discuss what comes next.
Halsin has returned to the grove. He should be able to help us with our parasite now. We should speak to him.
Halsin thanked us and assured us that Rath would reward us for rescuing him.

objectives.title: Meet Halsin at camp.
journalEntries: We found the missing druid Halsin. He can't heal us, but we might find answers at Moonrise Towers. He'll meet us at camp to discuss our next move.
With the goblin leaders dead, Halsin and the grove can rest easy. He'll meet us at camp to discuss our next move.

objectives.title: Learn more about Halsin.
journalEntries: Halsin was defeated before he could help us with the parasite. Maybe his research can be of use.

objectives.title: Celebrate at camp.
journalEntries: Grateful for our help, the tieflings are celebrating our victory. Time to have some fun.

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: We met the druid Halsin. He cannot cure us, but will join us as we embark for Moonrise Towers. There, we may discover more about our infection.
With the grove's fate decided, Halsin has joined us as we embark for Moonrise Towers. There, we may discover more about our infection.
We found a diary written by the druid Halsin. In it, he talks about the parasites originating in Moonrise Towers.
Halsin believed that the parasites are coming from Moonrise Towers.
The tieflings and the druids were defeated. It's unlikely Halsin will help us now.
We left the area without seeing if the druid Halsin could help us.

entries.name: Rescue Volo
entries.description: We found Volo performing for the goblins under significant duress. He was led into the camp's interior by a guard - he clearly needs help.
entries.section: Act One / Goblin Camp and Shattered Sanctum

objectives.title: Rescue Volo.
journalEntries: We found Volo performing for the goblins under significant duress. He was led into the camp's interior by a guard - he clearly needs help.
Volo is locked in a cage. There must be a way to get him out.

objectives.title: Return to Camp.
journalEntries: We freed Volo. He'll meet us back at camp.

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: Volo has decided to remain in our camp. Having such a learned scholar nearby might be useful.
Volo died.
We left for Baldur's Gate without rescuing Volo.

entries.name: Avenge Glut's Circle
entries.description: A myconid named Glut heard the Sovereign ask us to kill the duergar. It wants to join us.

objectives.title: Speak with Glut.
journalEntries: A myconid named Glut heard the Sovereign ask us to kill the duergar. It wants to join us.
Glut, a powerful myconid, offered to help us kill the duergar, but we declined.

objectives.title: Kill the duergar.
journalEntries: The myconid Glut joined our party to help us kill the duergar.
We changed our minds and decided to accept Glut's help.
We left the Underdark. Glut can't stand the sunlight and will stay behind until we return.

objectives.title: Return to Glut.
journalEntries: We defeated the duergar. Glut is pleased.

objectives.title: Show the dead duergar to Glut.
journalEntries: Glut wishes to see the defeated duergar. We agreed to escort it to the bodies.

objectives.title: Defeat Sovereign Spaw
journalEntries: Glut wants us to kill Sovereign Spaw so it can become the new ruler of the circle.
We agreed to help Glut kill Spaw.
We attacked Sovereign Spaw. The other myconids came to its aid.

objectives.title: Speak with Glut/Talk to Glut at the Myconid Circle.
journalEntries: Sovereign Spaw is defeated. We should speak to the Glut - the new Sovereign.
Glut knows Sovereign Spaw has been defeated. It wants to speak to us at the Myconid Circle.

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: (Refuse) "We refused to help destroy Sovereign Spaw. Glut attacked us.
(Accept) "Sovereign Glut rewarded us and named us King-Bringer.
Glut died.
We left the region without helping Glut.

entries.name: Defeat the Duergar Intruders
entries.description: We agreed to help the Sovereign remove the duergar who threatened the myconid colony.

objectives.title: Kill the duergar by the lake.
journalEntries: We agreed to help the Sovereign remove the duergar who threatened the myconid colony.
We found the duergar in the ruins of an abandoned settlement.
We fought the duergar.

objectives.title: Report back to the Myconid Sovereign.
journalEntries: We defeated the duergar. The Sovereign will be pleased.

objectives.title: Reach the Sovereign's refuge.
journalEntries: The Sovereign promised us a reward. The 'guardian gate' has been opened for us.

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: We reached the sovereign's refuge, where we found a long-dead drow scholar. Fortunately for us, he'd left plenty of valuables behind.
The Sovereign died before we could fulfil its request.
We left the region without helping the Sovereign.

entries.name: Deliver Nere's Head
entries.description: Sovereign Spaw wants the head of the drow Nere.

objectives.title: Kill Nere.
journalEntries: Sovereign Spaw wants the head of the drow Nere.
Sovereign Glut also wants Nere's head.
Several duergar are plotting against Nere. We've agreed to help, and they should support us when the time comes to kill Nere.
Sovereign Spaw is defeated. Perhaps Sovereign Glut will reward us for killing Nere.

objectives.title: Take Nere's head.
journalEntries: Nere is dead. We need to take his head to the Myconid Sovereign.
Nere died in the cave-in. Now we just need to cut off his head, and deliver it to the Myconid Sovereign.

objectives.title: Return to the Myconid Sovereign.
journalEntries: Nere is dead, and we have his head. The Sovereign Spaw will be pleased.
Nere is dead, and we have his head. Sovereign Glut will be pleased.

objectives.title: Find the new Sovereign.
journalEntries: Nere is dead, and we have his head. Another Myconid Sovereign might want it.

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: Sovereign Spaw rewarded us for delivering Nere's head.
Sovereign Glut rewarded us for delivering Nere's head.
There are no Myconid Sovereigns left to reward us for Nere's head.
We couldn't retrieve Nere's head.

entries.name: Cure the Poisoned Gnome
entries.description: We met Thulla, a deep gnome who was poisoned. The Underdark might hold a cure, but we have to be quick, she won't survive for long.

objectives.title: Find a cure for Thulla.
journalEntries: We met Thulla, a deep gnome who was poisoned. The Underdark might hold a cure, but we have to be quick, she won't survive for long.
Some time has passed, and Thulla's condition may have worsened. We need to find the cure before it's too late.
Thulla is on death's door. The poison will kill her soon - we can't afford to rest.

objectives.title: Cure Thulla.
journalEntries: We found an antidote. Maybe this will help Thulla.
We found an extremely rare noblestalk mushroom, famous for its healing properties. It could help Thulla, or it could help us get rich.

objectives.title: Check in on Thulla.
journalEntries: Thulla underwent an unusual transformation - we should check in on her.

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: We cured Thulla - she was very thankful.
Thulla died before being cured.
We're too late. Thulla died, and the myconids transformed her.
We left Thulla behind.

entries.name: Find the Missing Boots
entries.description: We offered to help a duergar to track down a runaway slave. The slave escaped with a pair of boots belonging to the duergar's sergeant.

objectives.title: Find the deep gnome runaway.
journalEntries: We offered to help a duergar to track down a runaway slave. The slave escaped with a pair of boots belonging to the duergar's sergeant.
A duergar ordered us to find a runaway slave if we wanted to live. The slave has a pair of boots that belong to the duergar's sergeant.
The duergar died before we could find the slave. If we find the boots, we should bring them to their original owner - the duergar's sergeant.

objectives.title: Get the boots
journalEntries: We finally found Thulla, the deep gnome slave. She must have the boots.
We killed Thulla to get the boots. (Boots can be looted.)
We cured Thulla -- she was very thankful. (Boots are gifted for curing Thulla)
We found the corpse of a deep gnome. This must be the runaway slave - she won't be needing those boots anymore.

objectives.title: Talk to Sergeant Thrinn.
journalEntries: Thulla gave us the boots. Their original owner is probably still interested in getting them back.
Gekh Coal reminded us to bring the boots to his sergeant, Thrinn.
Gekh Coal died. We should bring the boots to their original owner - the duergar sergeant.
We took the boots off the gnome's body. The duergar sergeant probably still wants them.
We should give the boots to the duergar sergeant.
We took the boots from the injured gnome - she was too weak to stop us.

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: The duergar are hostile. Delivering the boots is probably not an option anymore.
We returned Sergeant Thrinn's boots.
We gave the boots to Sergeant Thrinn and were rewarded.
Things turned violent with Sergeant Thrinn.
Sergeant Thrinn died before we could return her boots.
We left the region without returning Sergeant Thrinn's boots.
The duergar left without her boots.

entries.name: Find the Mushroom Picker
entries.description: Derryth told us about her husband Baelen. He's lost somewhere in the Underdark.

objectives.title: Find Baelen.
journalEntries: Derryth told us about her husband Baelen. He's lost somewhere in the Underdark.
We got a description of Baelen. He's bald and wearing a blue tunic. He is also, apparently, not very smart.

objectives.title: Save Baelen.
