journalEntries: We found Baelen trapped in a field of Bibberbangs. He begged us to throw him his bag.

objectives.title: Learn more about the dead dwarf.
journalEntries: The dwarf died before we could help him. What was he even doing down here?

objectives.title: Talk to Baelen.
journalEntries: We rescued Baelen. We should check on him.

objectives.title: Speak with Derryth.
journalEntries: We saved Baelen. We should tell Derryth the good news.
Baelen died. We should let Derryth know.
Baelen's corpse told us he was sent here by someone called Derryth. We should find her and tell her what happened.

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: While it wasn't a joyful reunion, Derryth has her husband back now.
We told Derryth that her husband is dead. She didn't seem particularly upset.
Derryth died.
We left the region without helping Derryth.

entries.name: Help Omeluum Investigate the Parasite
entries.description: We mentioned the parasite to Blurg, a hobgoblin. His colleague, a mind flayer named Omeluum, offered to examine it. Perhaps it can cure us?

objectives.title: Let Omeluum examine the parasite.
journalEntries: We mentioned the parasite to Blurg, a hobgoblin. His colleague, a mind flayer named Omeluum, offered to examine it. Perhaps it can cure us?

objectives.title: Ask Omeluum how to negate the tadpole's magic.
journalEntries: The mind flayer couldn't extract the parasite, but offered us a way to negate the magic protecting it.

objectives.title: Find the mushrooms Omeluum requested.
journalEntries: To help us, Omeluum requires a Tongue of Madness mushroom and some Timmask Spores. We can find both at the mysterious tower nearby.
We found some Timmask Spores. We'll need to bring them back to Omeluum once we find the Tongue of Madness.
We found the Tongue of Madness. We'll need to bring it back to Omeluum along with the Timmask Spores.

objectives.title: Drink the potion Omeluum made for us.
journalEntries: Before Omeluum can start the procedure, we'll need to drink the potion it made from the mushrooms we found.

objectives.title: Get the Ring of Mind Shielding from Omeluum.
journalEntries: The potion Omeluum gave us didn't work - it made the parasite even stronger. To calm it down, Omeluum is willing to trade us a ring of mind shielding.

objectives.title: Quest Completed!
journalEntries: We left the area before Omeluum could help. We'll need to find a cure somewhere else.

entries.name: Travel through the Underdark
entries.description: We learned that the best way to get to Moonrise Towers is through the Underdark. Tunnels beneath the temple of Selûne will lead us there.

objectives.title: Travel through the Temple of Selûne.
journalEntries: Halsin told us that there is a way to Moonrise Towers that leads through the Underdark. Tunnels beneath the temple of Selûne will lead us there.
We learned that the best way to get to Moonrise Towers is through the Underdark. Tunnels beneath the temple of Selûne will lead us there.

objectives.title: Find the secret entrance to the Underdark.
journalEntries: We found the old temple of Selûne. The entrance to the Underdark must be here somewhere.

objectives.title: Unlock the secret entrance to the Underdark.
journalEntries: A room in the old temple of Selûne contains a secret entrance to the Underdark. Through it, we can reach Moonrise Towers.

objectives.title: Go through the secret entrance.
journalEntries: We unlocked a secret door in the old temple of Selûne. It leads to the Underdark.

objectives.title: Explore the Underdark.
journalEntries: The Underdark is a twisted labyrinth of tunnels and ruins. To find the path to Moonrise Towers, we'll need to explore.

objectives.title: Reach Moonrise Towers through Grymforge.
journalEntries: We learned that the Absolute sent agents to Grymforge. There must be a route connecting Grymforge and Moonrise Towers.
We discovered a lift in Grymforge that can bring us closer to Moonrise Towers. However, we were warned of a darkness that plagues the surface.
Reach Moonrise Towers through Grymforge.

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: We used the lift in Grymforge and arrived in the shadow-cursed lands.
We decided to take the mountain pass. This road should lead us to Moonrise Towers.

entries.name: Blind the Absolute
entries.description: We agreed to help Brithvar and his group double-cross Nere. First, we need to take out the scrying eye - discreetly.

objectives.title: Destroy the scrying eye.
journalEntries: We agreed to help Brithvar and his group double-cross Nere. First, we need to take out the scrying eye - discreetly.
Brithvar is defeated. It's probably still worth destroying the scrying eye.

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: We destroyed the scrying eye and completed our part of the deal.
The cave-in was cleared before we could deal with the scrying eye. Perhaps the duergar will still double-cross Nere. Or perhaps not.
We dealt with other matters instead.

entries.name: Find Explosives
entries.description: Brithvar mentioned that a deep gnome fled with some smokepowder. Her crew should know more.

objectives.title: Find smokepowder.
journalEntries: Brithvar mentioned that a deep gnome fled with some smokepowder. Her crew should know more.

objectives.title: Go to the deep gnome's hiding spot.
journalEntries: We learned that the deep gnomes have a hiding spot in Grymforge. Philomeen might be there - with explosives.
We have some smokepowder. If it's not enough to blow the cave-in, Philomeen might have more. She fled to a hiding spot deep within Grymforge.

objectives.title: Find the smokepowder reserve.
journalEntries: Philomeen left behind a reserve of smokepowder. It should clear the cave-in.

objectives.title: Try to clear the cave-in.
journalEntries: We met Philomeen and managed to talk her down. She gave us a small vial of runepowder - a gnomish explosive of legend.

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: The cave-in was cleared.
We used all the explosives we found - but we didn't clear the cave-in.
We dealt with other matters instead.

entries.name: Free True Soul Nere
entries.description: Sergeant Thrinn said the True-Soul leading them is trapped behind the cave-in. She wants us to clear it.

objectives.title: Clear the cave-in.
journalEntries: Sergeant Thrinn said the True-Soul leading them is trapped behind the cave-in. She wants us to clear it.
The deep gnomes are worried about Beldron. He's trapped with True Soul Nere behind the cave-in.
We discovered several duergar who are plotting against Nere. They asked us to free him, and offered a cut of the prize if we help.
We found some explosives. Let's see if it's enough to clear the cave-in.
We found some rubble and were able to clear it. We should do the same for the cave-in.
We managed to clear some but not all of the rubble.
We used other methods to clear the rubble. Perhaps this could come in handy again.
True Soul Nere warned us about the poisonous gas behind the cave-in. He'll die soon - we can't afford to rest.

objectives.title: Speak to Nere.
journalEntries: We managed to clear the cave-in. Let's see what Nere has to say for himself.
The duergar were defeated. We should check on Nere.

objectives.title: Defeat the mutinous duergar.
journalEntries: The duergar turned on Nere. We need to protect him.

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: The cave-in was cleared without our help.
Nere mentioned that he's planning to go to the temple where he'll pick up the trail of Balthazar, the General's advisor.
We revealed the truth to Nere - that the Absolute is a front for mind flayers. He gave us a token of his thanks.
We turned on Nere.
Nere is dead.
We left Grymforge without clearing the cave-in.
We left Grymforge - leaving Nere to his fate.

entries.name: Get Past the Rubble
entries.description: We found a passage buried in rubble that leads to the Adamantine Forge. We should clear it.

objectives.title: Clear the rubble.
journalEntries: We found a passage buried in rubble that leads to the Adamantine Forge. We should clear it.

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: We destroyed the rubble.
We got past the rubble.
We left Grymforge without reaching the Adamantine Forge.

entries.name: Help the Spirit of the Amulet
entries.description: We read the journal of a Dark Justiciar. He mentioned an amulet of great power that also made the wearer laugh. It was cast into the lava.
entries.wikiTitle: Help the Spirit of the Amulet

objectives.title: Find the lost amulet.
journalEntries: We read the journal of a Dark Justiciar. He mentioned an amulet of great power that also made the wearer laugh. It was cast into the lava.

objectives.title: Travel to Wyrm's Crossing.
journalEntries: We found the amulet. It's been possessed by a spirit. The spirit wishes to be returned to his granddaughter. She lives at the Open Hand Temple in Wyrm's Crossing.
The longer we have the amulet, the worse the curse becomes.

objectives.title: Find Shirra Clarwen
journalEntries: We reached the Open Hand Temple. We should look for the spirit's granddaughter - Shirra Clarwen.

objectives.title: Bring the spirit of the amulet to Shirra.
journalEntries: We learned that Shirra Clarwen passed away. She is buried in a crypt under the temple.

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: The spirit possessed Shirra's body. We refused to take on his madness, putting a stop to him instead. His spirit will forever remain cursed.
The spirit possessed Shirra's body. We agreed to take on the curse of his madness, allowing his spirit to pass on.
We no longer have the amulet.

entries.name: Save the Grymforge Gnomes
entries.description: Thulla, a gnome of the Ironhand clan, asked us to help her kin. Duergar are holding them captive.

objectives.title: Free the deep gnomes.
journalEntries: Thulla, a gnome of the Ironhand clan, asked us to help her kin. Duergar are holding them captive.
We ran into Barcus Wroot. He's a prisoner at the duergar camp and clearly needs saving - again.
We spoke to some gnome captives. Their leader Beldron is trapped in the cave-in, and their friend Philomeen ran off with some explosives.
We found Philomeen - she wants nothing to do with the other deep gnomes. We should focus on helping the others.

objectives.title: Check on the survivors.
journalEntries: We cleared the cave-in. We should check for survivors.

objectives.title: Defeat the cultists.
journalEntries: True Soul Nere wants the gnomes dead, but we refused. We've made an enemy of him.
We sided with the duergar mercenaries. Nere is in for a fight.

objectives.title: Defeat the Duergar.
journalEntries: We fought alongside the duergar mutineers - only to have them turn on us.

objectives.title: Talk to the deep gnomes
journalEntries: The deep gnomes are free. We should speak to them.

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: The Ironhand Gnomes plan to return to Baldur's Gate without their leader Wulbren, who has been taken to Moonrise Towers.
Barcus was grateful that we saved him - again. He's planning to rescue his old friend Wulbren from Moonrise Towers. We should let Thulla know what happened.
True Soul Nere killed all the deep gnomes.
We initially defended the deep gnomes but then sided with True Soul Nere.
The deep gnomes and their captors are gone. We missed our chance to rescue them.
We allowed the duergar to keep the deep gnomes as slaves.
All the deep gnomes in Grymforge have been defeated.
We freed the deep gnomes in Grymforge and left.
We left without helping the deep gnomes.

entries.name: The Adamantine Forge
entries.description: We learned than an adamantine forge is hidden deep within the Underdark.

entries.name: Find the Blood of Lathander
entries.description: We learned that a powerful holy relic, the Blood of Lathander, could be somewhere nearby. We should keep an eye out for it as we explore the monastery.

objectives.title: Explore Rosymorn Monastery.
journalEntries: We learned that a powerful holy relic, the Blood of Lathander, could be somewhere nearby. We should keep an eye out for it as we explore the monastery.
We learned from a dead pilgrim that a powerful holy relic, the Blood of Lathander, could be somewhere nearby. We should keep an eye out for it as we explore the Monastery.
We found a note from a Lathander worshipper about a precious relic called 'The Blood' hidden somewhere in Rosymorn Monastery. Perhaps we can find it in our exploration.

objectives.title: Find the true Blood of Lathander.
journalEntries: A fake artefact in Rosymorn Monastery was disguised as the Blood of Lathander - we should keep looking for the true relic.

objectives.title: Explore the Secret Chamber.
journalEntries: We moved some ancient Lathanderian statues and a secret passageway opened - we should see what lies within.

objectives.title: Find a purpose for the Dawnmaster's Crest.
journalEntries: We found an oddly shaped crest that belonged to a high priest of Lathander. Perhaps it can help us find the Blood of Lathander?

objectives.title: Get past the Secret Chamber's Lathanderian traps.
journalEntries: Very elaborate traps block our path down this passageway - whatever sits at the end must be worth protecting.

objectives.title: Retrieve the relic.
journalEntries: We bested the Secret Chamber's traps - we should see what they were guarding.

objectives.title: Escape the exploding Rosymorn Monastery.
journalEntries: We took the Blood of Lathander and sprung a trap that will destroy the Monastery, Crèche Y'llek underneath it, and us if we don't stop it or escape.

objectives.title: Quest Compete
journalEntries: We disarmed the Monastery's powerful trap, saving Crèche Y'llek and ourselves - and escaped with the Blood of Lathander.
We escaped the Monastery's powerful trap with the Blood of Lathander in tow - but Crèche Y'llek was destroyed in the process.
We used the Dawnmaster's Crest to safely retrieve the Blood of Lathander - Morninglord be praised.
We left the Blood of Lathander somewhere deep within Rosymorn Monastery.

entries.name: Find the Githyanki Crèche
entries.description: Lae'zel told us that the githyanki should be able to cure us, if we can find one of their crèches.

objectives.title: Find Zorru.
journalEntries: Lae'zel told us that the githyanki should be able to cure us, if we can find one of their crèches. Someone named Zorru should know more.
We found Zorru. Lae'zel will want to speak with him.

objectives.title: Find a Githyanki Crèche.
journalEntries: Lae'zel says that we can be cured at a Githyanki Crèche and hopes to find her kin nearby.
Zorru is dead. We'll have to find another lead to the Githyanki Crèche.
Zorru left the grove. We'll have to find another lead to the Githyanki Crèche.
We spoke to a tiefling called Zorru. He wouldn't tell us anything about the githyanki he'd seen. We'll have to find them ourselves.

objectives.title: Find the Githyanki patrol.
journalEntries: We learned of a githyanki patrol to the northwest. They might be able to lead us to their crèche.

objectives.title: Speak to the leader of the githyanki patrol.
journalEntries: We found the githyanki Zorru mentioned near the mountain pass. We should speak to them - they may know where we can find a Githyanki Crèche to cure our illithid infection.

objectives.title: Find the Githyanki Crèche.
journalEntries: We found the githyanki patrol, but they weren't very cooperative. We still don't know where the crèche is - we'll need to find it ourselves.

objectives.title: Search the githyanki corpses for information.
journalEntries: Lae'zel told us of a cure we can find at a Githyanki Crèche. She thinks one of the patrol will have a map. We should search the corpses.
We defeated Sarth Baretha and her squadron - we should search her body for more information about the nearby crèche.

objectives.title: Reach the Githyanki Crèche.
journalEntries: We learned where the crèche is located. We should see if we can find answers there.

objectives.title: Find the Githyanki Crèche's entrance.
journalEntries: The Githyanki Crèche is nestled somewhere within Rosymorn Monastery. We should take a look.

objectives.title: Find the Githyanki cure.
journalEntries: We've reached the crèche. Lae'zel says there should be some kind of device capable of removing the parasite. We just need to find it.
We've reached the crèche. Without Lae'zel's guidance, it may be harder to find the cure she mentioned.

objectives.title: Go to the Crèche Infirmary.
journalEntries: The guards told us to report to the Crèche Infirmary, where the doctor will inspect us.
Vlaakith and Inquisitor W'wargaz tried to kill us. It might still be worth investigating the Crèche Infirmary for a way to remove our parasites.

objectives.title: Speak to Ghustil Stornugoss.
journalEntries: We found the Crèche Infirmary - we should speak to whoever runs it.
The ghustil, this crèche's medical expert, may have a way to cure our illithid infection.
Though Vlaakith and the Inquisitor tried to kill us, we should still speak to the ghustil. We may still be able to cleanse our illithid parasite.

objectives.title: Sit in the zaith'isk.
journalEntries: Ghustil Stornugoss, the doctor, said the zaith'isk can extract our parasites. However, it sounds dangerous.
Ghustil Stornugoss, the doctor, is dead. There might still be a way to operate the githyanki purification device.

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: We attempted to remove our parasites using the githyanki purification device, but it failed and almost killed us. Our parasites must be very unusual.
We activated a self-destruct mechanism, which blew up the Githyanki Crèche. The githyanki purification device will undoubtedly have been destroyed along with it.
There is no time to look for a cure in the Githyanki Crèche anymore. We must press on.

entries.name: Reclaim the Blue Jay's Nest
entries.description: We met a blue jay who asked us to kill the eagles on the monastery roof. He claimed they stole his nest.

objectives.title: Kill the eagles.
journalEntries: We met a blue jay who asked us to kill the eagles on the monastery roof. He claimed they stole his nest.
We found eagles nesting on the roof of the monastery. These must be the ones the blue jay was talking about.

objectives.title: Speak to the blue jay.
journalEntries: We dealt with the eagles. We should tell the blue jay.

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: The blue jay was thrilled to have his nest back.
The blue jay is dead. He won't be needing a nest.
We can no longer return to the monastery. The blue jay is on his own.
Using the lance scared the birds off, including the eagles and the blue jay. It seems none of them will be needing the nest.

entries.name: Steal a Githyanki Egg
entries.description: Lady Esther has asked that we steal an egg from the githyanki. The Society of Brilliance want to incubate it, raise it, and soothe its so-called violent nature.

objectives.title: Search the Githyanki Crèche for an egg.
journalEntries: Lady Esther has asked that we steal an egg from the githyanki. The Society of Brilliance want to incubate it, raise it, and soothe its so-called violent nature.
We convinced Lady Esther to pay us to steal the githyanki egg up front.

objectives.title: Take the egg from the Hatchery.
journalEntries: We learned of an egg being kept in the githyanki Hatchery. It's guarded by a caretaker and two guards. There must be some way to steal it.

objectives.title: Take the egg to Lady Esther.
journalEntries: We snatched the githyanki egg from the Hatchery. Lady Esther will pay us handsomely for it.

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: The githyanki egg has been destroyed.
We kicked the egg off a cliff.
We tricked Lady Esther into taking an owlbear egg instead. She thanked us, and rewarded us.
We gave Lady Esther the githyanki egg. She appreciated our help and rewarded us.
Lady Esther is gone. There's no chance of giving her an egg now.
We tricked Lady Esther into taking an owlbear egg instead.
We gave Lady Esther the githyanki egg. She appreciated our help.

entries.name: Travel through the Mountain Pass
entries.description: We decided to take the mountain pass. This road should lead us to Moonrise Towers.

objectives.title: Reach the mountain pass.
journalEntries: Halsin told us that there is a way to Moonrise Towers through a mountain pass, but that it may be dangerous.

objectives.title: Speak to Minthara in the Goblin Camp.
journalEntries: True Soul Nere spoke of a General who resides in Moonrise Towers. If we want answers about our parasites, we'll need to head there. Minthara in the Goblin Camp knows of a way to safely traverse the cursed lands.

objectives.title: Raid the Emerald Grove.
journalEntries: We agreed to help Minthara raid the Emerald Grove.

objectives.title: Celebrate with Minthara.
journalEntries: Minthara has promised us a reward for helping her crush the Emerald Grove. We should meet her at our camp to celebrate - and to receive our prize.

objectives.title: Travel through the mountain pass.
journalEntries: Nere warned us that we cannot travel through the mountain pass without protection, but Minthara can no longer help us. We might just have to brave the curse.
Minthara told us of a creature in her service who can guide us safely to Moonrise Towers. We can meet him and his minions at the mountain pass.

objectives.title: Follow the mountain pass.
journalEntries: We decided to take the mountain pass. This road should lead us to Moonrise Towers.
We find a corpse who tells us he came from Moonrise Towers on orders from General Thorm. We're heading in the right direction.

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: We took the mountain pass and arrived in the shadow-cursed lands.
We used the lift in Grymforge and arrived in the shadow-cursed lands.

entries.name: Break Yurgir's Contract
entries.description: The orthon is bound by Raphael's contract and seeks a way to free himself from it.

objectives.title: Investigate the Gauntlet of Shar for clues.
journalEntries: The orthon is bound by Raphael's contract and seeks a way to free himself from it.
We came upon a mysterious ritual site. It seems one of the orthon's targets has assumed a new shape.
We spoke to the pile of corpses that serves as the orthon's bed. It mentioned that the orthon's last target is now 'many'.
We learned that the rats in the Gauntlet of Shar are actually one, single person - a man called Lyrthindor.

objectives.title: Deal with the Last Justiciar.
journalEntries: We discovered that the Last Justiciar's body was disassembled into a swarm of rats. Now that he's returned to his true form, we can kill him.

objectives.title: Return to Yurgir.
journalEntries: We have dealt with the Last Justiciar, whose body had disassembled into a swarm of rats. Yurgir's contract can now be ended.

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: We helped the orthon break free from his contract - but it seems that Raphael had already planned for the outcome.
We moved on before we could break the orthon's contract.
We killed the orthon without resolving his contract.
We told the rat that we would leave them alone.
We made a deal with the rats. In return for being left alone, they told us about a cache of hidden treasure.

entries.name: Find Arabella's Parents
entries.description: We met Arabella, a tiefling child from the grove, in the shadow-cursed lands. She was looking for her parents. We offered to search for them, and invited her to our camp.

objectives.title: Search for Arabella's parents.
journalEntries: We met Arabella, a tiefling child from the grove, in the shadow-cursed lands. She was looking for her parents. We offered to search for them, and invited her to our camp.
We met Arabella, a tiefling child from the grove, in the shadow-cursed lands. She was looking for her parents.

objectives.title: Speak to Arabella.
journalEntries: We met Arabella, a tiefling child from the grove, in the shadow-cursed lands. We told her that her parents were dead, but invited her to join our camp.

objectives.title: Tell Arabella about her parents.
journalEntries: We found Arabella's parents - dead. We should break the news to her at camp.

objectives.title: Check up on Arabella.
journalEntries: Arabella was very upset when we broke the news to her about her parents. We should check up on her once she's had some time to process the news.

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: Arabella fled into the shadow curse upon hearing what happened to her parents. It is unlikely that she will survive.
Withers encouraged Arabella to learn the ways of the Weave. She left to find her own way in the world.
We never did tell Arabella that her parents died.
We never did find Arabella's parents. They must have succumbed to the shadow curse.
We moved on from the shadow-cursed lands without helping Arabella. She left us a note, saying she would make her own way - letting the Weave guide her.

entries.name: Find Rolan in the Shadows
entries.description: Rolan has disappeared into the darkness. He left a message for his siblings to wait for him at Last Light. He's out in the shadow curse alone. We should look for him.

objectives.title: Bring Rolan safely back to Last Light.
journalEntries: Rolan has disappeared into the darkness. He left a message for his siblings to wait for him at Last Light. He's out in the shadow curse alone. We should look for him.

objectives.title: Help Rolan defeat the shadows.
journalEntries: Rolan is in trouble. We should help him.

objectives.title: Speak to Rolan at Last Light.
journalEntries: Safe once more, an embarrassed Rolan headed back to Last Light. We should meet him there.

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: Rolan's family are finally safe, and together once more in Last Light.
With Lia dead, Rolan and Cal will never be the same.
With Cal dead, Rolan and Lia will never be the same.
Rolan has reunited with Lia at Last Light.
Rolan has reunited with Cal at Last Light.
Rolan died.
With Last Light gone, Rolan will never see his family again.
We left the shadow-cursed lands without speaking to Rolan in Last Light.
We left the shadow-cursed lands without helping Rolan.
Rolan's reunion with his siblings didn't go as expected, and they separated on bad terms.

entries.name: Investigate the Selûnite Resistance
entries.description: We found the old notes of a Sharran inquisitor. She had been investigating rumours of clandestine Selûne-worship in the region, and had been following a lead to an abandoned potter's workshop. Perhaps we should look for it.

objectives.title: Investigate the abandoned potter's workshop.
journalEntries: We found the old notes of a Sharran inquisitor. She had been investigating rumours of clandestine Selûne-worship in the region, and had been following a lead to an abandoned potter's workshop. Perhaps we should look for it.
We found a stash of Selûnite relics in the abandoned potter's workshop, as well as a note suggesting there may be more at Last Light Inn.

objectives.title: Investigate Last Light Inn.
journalEntries: It looks like there was a burgeoning Selûnite resistance to Sharran control of the region a hundred years ago. We should investigate further in Last Light Inn.
We found a stash of Selûnite relics in Last Light Inn. It seems the innkeeper's owner, a mason called Morfred, was the leader of a resistance movement against the Sharrans.

objectives.title: Investigate the Masons' Guild.
journalEntries: The Mason's Guild seems to have been the centre of the Selûnite resistance in the area. We should seek it out and investigate further.

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: We reached the Masons' Guild and found the writings of Morfred, leader of the Selûnite resistance. He was determined to fight on against the Sharrans however he could, even if it cost him his life.
We continued on our journey without completing our investigation into signs of Selûnite resistance.

entries.name: Kill Raphael's Old Enemy
entries.description: Raphael told us of a nemesis of his who lurks in the depths beneath the mausoleum. Evidently we should try to deal with this old enemy.

objectives.title: Deal with Raphael's Old Enemy
journalEntries: Raphael told us of a nemesis of his who lurks in the depths beneath the mausoleum. Evidently we should try to deal with this old enemy.
We discovered signs of destruction throughout the temple. We can likely follow the trail of carnage to Raphael's old acquaintance.
We encountered Raphael's old enemy - an orthon named Yurgir.
The orthon revealed the details of his contract with Raphael - he can only leave the temple once he has killed the last Sharran in residence.

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: We slew the orthon.
We convinced the orthon of another way to escape the temple - by killing himself and returning to the Nine Hells.
We moved on before meeting Raphael's old enemy.
We helped the orthon break free from his contract - but it seems that Raphael had already planned for the outcome.

entries.name: Lift the Shadow Curse
entries.description: According to Halsin, if we want to lift the shadow curse, we must find Thaniel - the spirit of the land.

objectives.title: Look for clues as to Thaniel's whereabouts.
journalEntries: According to Halsin, if we want to lift the shadow curse, we must find Thaniel - the spirit of the land.

objectives.title: Tell Halsin about Art Cullagh.
journalEntries: We found a mysterious man lying unconscious in Last Light Inn. He said the name 'Thaniel' while sleeping. We should tell Halsin about this.

objectives.title: Wake Art Cullagh.
journalEntries: Halsin met the mysterious unconscious man, and is certain he knows where Thaniel is. Halsin suggested something from the man's past might help to wake him.

objectives.title: Talk to Halsin about Art Cullagh.
journalEntries: We managed to wake the mysterious man - a Flaming Fist called Art Cullagh. He immediately asked to speak to Halsin, saying the druid was the only one who could help.

objectives.title: Meet Halsin by the lakeshore.
journalEntries: Halsin has a plan to save Thaniel, and lift the shadow curse. He asked us to meet him by the lakeshore by Last Light.

objectives.title: Defend the portal.
journalEntries: Halsin delved into the Shadowfell to rescue Thaniel. We must defend the portal Halsin created, or he will be trapped in the Shadowfell forever.

objectives.title: Meet Halsin at camp.
journalEntries: Halsin rescued Thaniel from the Shadowfell, but the spirit of the land is ill. If we want to help, we should speak to Halsin at camp.

objectives.title: Seek Thaniel's Shadow.
journalEntries: Halsin has told us to seek a place where flowers still grow in the shadow-cursed lands. Among the blooms we might locate Thaniel's missing half, the key to curing his illness.

objectives.title: Speak to Halsin at camp.
journalEntries: It took some convincing, but Oliver agreed to reunite with Thaniel. We should check in with Halsin next time we're at camp, and see if Thaniel is doing any better.

objectives.title: Kill Ketheric Thorm.
journalEntries: Reuniting Oliver and Thaniel is not enough. Ketheric Thorm is the anchor of the curse. For the land to heal, he must be defeated.

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: Halsin is lost to the Shadowfell. Without him, we can't lift the shadow curse.
We left for Baldur's Gate without finding a way to lift the shadow curse. Halsin decided to stay behind to try and lift the curse without us.
We successfully lifted the shadow curse. In time, these lands will flourish once again.
Halsin died. Without him, we cannot lift the shadow curse.

entries.name: Punish the Wicked
entries.description: He Who Was wants to bring justice to the victims of a murderer - to do so, he needs a ledger belonging to the killer. It is hidden in The Waning Moon.

objectives.title: Find the ledger.
journalEntries: He Who Was wants to bring justice to the victims of a murderer - to do so, he needs a ledger belonging to the killer. It is hidden in The Waning Moon.

objectives.title: Give the ledger to He Who Was.
journalEntries: We found the ledger. We should give it to He Who Was.

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: We gave the ledger to He Who Was and punished the killer for her crimes. He was pleased.
We refused to give the ledger to He Who Was, and do not know what became of him.
He Who Was is no more.
He Who Was wanted Madeline punished - we forgave her instead. He was furious.
We forced He Who Was to stab himself over and over again during the ritual. He was furious.
We left the shadowlands and may never know what became of He Who Was.

entries.name: Wake Art Cullagh
entries.description: We met Art Cullagh, a mysterious man lying unconscious in Last Light Inn. He's being cared for by a Flaming Fist. He may have knowledge about the shadow curse. We should see if we can wake him somehow.

objectives.title: Find some clues about Art.
journalEntries: We met Art Cullagh, a mysterious man lying unconscious in Last Light Inn.
We heard Counsellor Florrick talking about a Flaming Fist found comatose in Last Light Inn. He may have knowledge about the shadow curse. We should see if we can wake him somehow.
We met Art Cullagh, a mysterious man lying unconscious in Last Light Inn. He's being cared for by a Flaming Fist.

objectives.title: Tell Halsin about Art Cullagh.
journalEntries: Art Cullagh whispered the name 'Thaniel' in his sleep - the spirit of the land that Halsin mentioned. We should tell Halsin about this.

objectives.title: Investigate the House of Healing.
journalEntries: We found Art's last orders - to investigate the House of Healing. If we follow in his footsteps, we might learn more about him.

objectives.title: Show the lute to Art.
journalEntries: We found a lute bearing Art's initials in the House of Healing. Maybe playing it for him will bring him back to his senses.
We met an unconscious Flaming Fist named Art Cullagh in Last Light Inn. The lute we found at the House of Healing bears his initials. Perhaps the two are connected?

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: We woke Art. He desperately wants to speak to Halsin about Thaniel - the spirit of the land, who he met in the Shadowfell.
Art despaired when he learned of Halsin's death. Without him, Thaniel is lost to the Shadowfell - and the shadow curse can never be lifted.
We woke Art. He told Halsin that he met the spirit of the land, Thaniel, in the Shadowfell.
Art Cullagh died before we could wake him.

entries.name: Capture Isobel the Selûnite Cleric
entries.description: Z'rell, Ketheric's enforcer, told us to kidnap Isobel from Last Light and bring her to Moonrise Towers. If we do this, Last Light will no longer be protected from the shadow curse.

objectives.title: Capture Isobel alive.
journalEntries: Z'rell, Ketheric's enforcer, told us to kidnap Isobel from Last Light and bring her to Moonrise Towers. If we do this, Last Light will no longer be protected from the shadow curse.
Ketheric told us to kidnap Isobel from Last Light and bring her to Moonrise Towers. If we do this, Last Light will no longer be protected from the shadow curse.

objectives.title: Report to Z'rell.
journalEntries: Isobel died during our attempt to abduct her, but a ghoul carried her off anyway. We should go to Moonrise Towers, and see what happened.
We captured Isobel. We should return to Moonrise Towers, and report back to Z'rell.

objectives.title: Report to Ketheric.
journalEntries: We tried to capture Isobel, but she died. We should return to Moonrise Towers, and report back to Ketheric.
We captured Isobel. We should return to Moonrise Towers, and report back to Ketheric.

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: We captured Isobel. Z'rell was pleased. She's granted us an audience with Ketheric at the rooftop chapel.
Our failure to bring Isobel angered Ketheric, but he will still allow us an audience with the Absolute.
We angered the denizens of Moonrise Towers; Z'rell may not want to reward us for abducting Isobel anymore.
We captured Isobel and sent her to Ketheric.

entries.name: Decide Minthara's Fate
entries.description: Nightwarden Minthara has been condemned to death. We ought to visit her while we can.

objectives.title: Check on Minthara.
journalEntries: Nightwarden Minthara has been condemned to death. We ought to visit her while we can.

objectives.title: (Optional) Defeat the jailers.
journalEntries: We've drawn the ire of Minthara's guards. We need to defeat them before we can aid her.

objectives.title: (Optional) Talk to Minthara.
journalEntries: We defeated Minthara's guards. We should talk to her.

objectives.title: Bring Minthara outside Moonrise Towers.
journalEntries: Minthara has asked for our help escaping Moonrise Towers. We'll have to escort her until we've put some distance between us and the forces of the Absolute stationed here.

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: [Minthara escaped, joined camp] "We helped Minthara escape Moonrise Towers. She went to our camp to recover from her ordeal.
[Minthara escaped, left] "We helped Minthara escape Moonrise Towers. She's elected to go her own way.
[Minthara died] "Minthara did not escape her fate at Moonrise, and she never will.
[Minthara's mind was erased] "Minthara's captors erased her free will completely. She is an obedient thrall, loyal to the Absolute, and without a personality of her own.

entries.name: Defeat Ketheric Thorm
entries.description: We battled Ketheric Thorm. Before we could finish him, he fled somewhere below the tower. We need to follow him.

objectives.title: Follow Ketheric.
journalEntries: We battled Ketheric Thorm. Before we could finish him, he fled somewhere below the tower. We need to follow him.

objectives.title: Escape Balthazar's lab.
journalEntries: Ketheric learned that the weapon he's searching for and the artefact we carry are one and the same. We've been teleported to a laboratory where Balthazar plans to remove us from the artefact's protection. We need to escape.

objectives.title: Search the Colony for Ketheric.
journalEntries: We pursued Ketheric beneath the tower and found ourselves in what appears to be a mind flayer colony. We need to find him.
We escaped Balthazar's laboratory and found ourselves in a mind flayer colony. We need to search for Ketheric.

objectives.title: Kill Ketheric Thorm.
journalEntries: We found Ketheric, along with a Bhaalist named Orin and a Banite called Gortash. They brandished a triad of magical stones that seem to give them control over an illithid elder brain. Orin and Gortash have taken the brain to Baldur's Gate aboard a nautiloid - leaving Ketheric to face us.

objectives.title: Obtain Ketheric Thorm's Netherstone.
journalEntries: Close to death, Ketheric transformed into an apostle of the dark deity Myrkul - and was defeated all the same. We should search his body for the stone he used to control the elder brain.

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: The gem we found on Ketheric's body is a Netherstone - one of three used to control the elder brain. Orin and Gortash carry the other two. If we want to cure ourselves and save the Sword Coast, we'll have to hunt the pair through Baldur's Gate and claim each of their Netherstones in turn.

entries.name: Find Ketheric Thorm's Relic
entries.description: Minthara told us that the necromancer Balthazar might know more about Ketheric's invulnerability. She suspects the answers we seek lie in Balthazar's chambers on the upper floor.

objectives.title: Search Balthazar's chambers.
journalEntries: Minthara told us that the necromancer Balthazar might know more about Ketheric's invulnerability. She suspects the answers we seek lie in Balthazar's chambers on the upper floor.

objectives.title: Investigate the Thorm Mausoleum.
journalEntries: Disciple Z'rell instructed us to assist General Thorm's advisor, Balthazar, in recovering a powerful relic from the Thorm's family mausoleum.
The Brewer revealed that 'her cage' is located in the Thorm Mausoleum. It's unclear who this woman is, but Ketheric must have caged her for a reason.
We found Balthazar's diary and learned that he went to the Thorm Mausoleum to find a relic called the 'Nightsong'. It seems to be the key to Ketheric's invulnerability.
A mysterious voice in the Mausoleum warned us to leave. If we wish to find Balthazar, we should press on.

objectives.title: Follow the secret passage.
journalEntries: We uncovered a secret passage in the Thorm Mausoleum. The relic must be further inside.

objectives.title: Find Balthazar.
journalEntries: We uncovered a secret passage in the Thorm Mausoleum. Balthazar must be inside.
We encountered a group of patrolling skeletons who likely serve Balthazar. They mentioned the temple's shadowy defenders.
We encountered Balthazar's undead servants. They have barricaded themselves in a room as they prepare to defend their master.

objectives.title: Talk to Balthazar.
journalEntries: We defeated the temple's shadowy defenders and found the missing Balthazar.

objectives.title: Find a path to the relic.
journalEntries: We found Balthazar. He's asked us to clear the path to the relic - by any means necessary.
We encountered Balthazar - General Ketheric Thorm's advisor. He's been tasked with finding a powerful relic. He asked us to clear the path - by any means necessary.
We defeated Balthazar, but the relic is still at large. We should search for it.

objectives.title: Complete the Gauntlet of Shar.
journalEntries: To enter the temple's Inner Sanctum, we must complete the Gauntlet of Shar - trials made for her elite soldiers, the Dark Justiciars.
We found an Umbral Gem. More are needed to unlock the temple's Inner Sanctum.
We acquired another Umbral Gem from one of Shar's trials.
We acquired a new Umbral Gem from Shar's trials.
We acquired an Umbral gem from the lair of the orthon.
We inserted an Umbral Gem into the altar. This activated a platform that will allow us to travel deeper into the temple.
We found an altar in front of a locked door. There are three slots for Umbral Gems. We'll need to find more if we want to enter the temple's Inner Sanctum.

objectives.title: Place Umbral Gemstone in Altar
journalEntries: We have enough Umbral Gems. We should insert them into the altar.

objectives.title: Open the door to the Inner Sanctum.
journalEntries: We've collected enough Umbral Gems. Now to gain access to the Inner Sanctum.
We inserted an Umbral Gem into the altar. This activated a platform that will allow us to travel deeper into the temple.

objectives.title: Find the relic.
journalEntries: The path to the Inner Sanctum is open. The relic lies just ahead.

objectives.title: Reach the relic.
journalEntries: Balthazar followed us into the Shadowfell. He intends to claim the relic. We should hurry after him.
We entered the Shadowfell, the heart of the relic.

objectives.title: Defeat Balthazar.
journalEntries: We found the 'relic' - a woman named Nightsong. Balthazar wanted to bring her to Ketheric. We turned on the necromancer instead.

objectives.title: Decide Nightsong's fate.
journalEntries: The relic is a woman called Nightsong who was trapped in the Shadowfell by Ketheric and Balthazar. Her fate is in our hands.

objectives.title: Report to Moonrise.
journalEntries: We helped Balthazar capture the Nightsong. He was pleased. We should return to Moonrise.

objectives.title: Report to Disciple Z'rell.
journalEntries: We helped Balthazar return Nightsong to Moonrise Towers. Disciple Z'rell would be happy to hear this.
Disciple Z'rell was pleased we assisted Balthazar and brought Nightsong to Moonrise.

objectives.title: Report to Ketheric Thorm.
journalEntries: We helped Balthazar return Nightsong to Moonrise Towers. Ketheric Thorm would be happy to hear this.
After capturing the Nightsong alongside Balthazar, we reported our success to Ketheric Thorm.

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: We killed Nightsong, making Ketheric Thorm vulnerable.
We freed Nightsong and she flew across the shadow-cursed lands to Moonrise Towers, where she intends to face Ketheric Thorm.

entries.name: Find Mol
entries.description: We found out that Mol, the leader of the young tiefling pickpockets, has vanished. We should help them find her.

objectives.title: Keep an eye out for Mol.
journalEntries: We found out that Mol, the leader of the young tiefling pickpockets, has vanished. We should help them find her.

objectives.title: Search for Mol in the Mind Flayer Colony.
journalEntries: We found Mol's eyepatch in Balthazar's Necrotic Laboratory. It was bloodied but intact. Maybe she's still somewhere in the Mind Flayer Colony.
There was no sign of Mol in the Tadpoling Centre of the Mind Flayer Colony. She must have found a way back out of this accursed place.

objectives.title: Search for Mol in Moonrise Towers.
journalEntries: We asked Balthazar about Mol, but he claimed he had no recollection of her. With any luck, she'll turn up once Moonrise Towers is safe from the cult of the Absolute.
We defeated Ketheric and watched a fleet of nautiloids leave for Baldur's Gate. If Mol doesn't turn up in Moonrise Towers, she may have escaped on one of them and made it to the city.

objectives.title: Search for Mol on the path to Baldur's Gate.
journalEntries: The powers behind the cult of the Absolute left Moonrise Towers, but Mol still hasn't shown up. We shouldn't lose hope - maybe we'll find her on the way to Baldur's Gate.

objectives.title: Search for Mol in Baldur's Gate.
journalEntries: Mattis heard that Mol made it safely to Baldur's Gate. This young crimelord-to-be is proving impressively difficult to track down - now we just have to find her in a bustling city.

objectives.title: Find Mol in Baldur's Gate.
journalEntries: We found the contract Mol signed with Raphael to escape the Absolute's clutches. If we take it to her, any debt she owes Raphael can be eliminated.

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: We found Mol not only alive but thriving, climbing the ranks of the Guildhall.
We never did manage to find Mol. We must press on.

entries.name: Find Zevlor
entries.description: Zevlor was captured by the cult of the Absolute. His fellow tieflings claim he froze and tried to surrender. We should look for him.

objectives.title: Find Zevlor.
journalEntries: Zevlor was captured by the cult of the Absolute. His fellow tieflings claim he froze and tried to surrender. We should look for him.

The tieflings were captured and brought to Moonrise Towers, but Zevlor isn't with them. His fellow tieflings are angry with him - claiming he wanted to surrender. Some even think he was secretly a cultist.
Something happened with Zevlor and the tieflings out in the darkness - something bad. And it sounds like the tieflings blame him for it. We should find out more.
We found the tieflings, but Zevlor isn't with them. They claim he wanted to surrender to the cult. Some even think he was secretly a cultist. We should look for him.
Arabella's father claims that Zevlor betrayed the tieflings, and tried to run.
The tieflings were ambushed by the cultists out in the darkness. Zevlor urged them to surrender, and in the confusion the cultists attacked - kidnapping several of the tieflings.

objectives.title: Free Zevlor.
journalEntries: We found Zevlor trapped in a pod - the same type we awoke in on the nautiloid. He will likely die without our help.

objectives.title: Help Zevlor.
journalEntries: We opened the pods - releasing a host of mind flayers. We're in for a fight.

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: We purged the mind flayer pods in the colony. Zevlor was in one of them - he must have perished.
We never found Zevlor.
We couldn't save Zevlor from his fate.
We saved Zevlor, who explained that he let the Absolute infiltrate his mind. It's unlikely the tieflings will welcome him back - he'll have to forge his own path now.

entries.name: Follow the Convoy
entries.description: We met a group of cultists preparing to travel to Moonrise Towers. They are waiting for a guide who must be summoned using an instrument the drow Minthara possessed.

objectives.title: Retrieve the instrument from the drow Minthara.
journalEntries: We met a group of cultists preparing to travel to Moonrise Towers. They are waiting for a guide who must be summoned using an instrument the drow Minthara possessed.

objectives.title: Find the cultist camp.
journalEntries: We reached the shadow-cursed lands. We can use Minthara's instrument to summon a creature to guide us to Moonrise Towers, but we need to find the right place to play it.
We met a goblin who told us of a group of cultists up ahead. We should check out their camp.

objectives.title: Summon the guide.
journalEntries: We met a group of cultists preparing to travel to Moonrise Towers. They are waiting for a guide. We should use Minthara's instrument to summon the guide.

objectives.title: Talk to the drider.
journalEntries: We summoned the drider. We should speak to him.

objectives.title: Follow the drider.
journalEntries: We need to stay close to the drider in order to reach Moonrise Towers.

objectives.title: Defend the convoy.
journalEntries: Harpers are attacking the convoy - we must defend it.

objectives.title: Continue toward Moonrise Towers.
journalEntries: We defeated the Harpers and should continue following the drider.

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: The drider can no longer aid us.
The drider made it to Moonrise Towers.
We turned against the drider and sided with the Harpers.
We reached Moonrise Towers without help from the cultists.

entries.name: Infiltrate Moonrise Towers
entries.description: The dream visitor told us to go to Moonrise Towers and infiltrate the cult of the Absolute. The cult's secrets may teach us how to free ourselves of these parasites.

objectives.title: Reach Moonrise Towers.
journalEntries: The dream visitor told us to go to Moonrise Towers and infiltrate the cult of the Absolute. The cult's secrets may teach us how to free ourselves of these parasites.
We reached the shadow-cursed lands. We should find Moonrise Towers, which is where the parasites are coming from.
We met a drider who worships the Absolute. He can lead us to the heart of the cult in Moonrise Towers, where we may find answers.
Harpers attacked the cultists we travelled with. We decided to help the Harpers, and fought against the cult.
We found a Moonlantern that will protect us from even the deepest parts of the shadow curse. With it, we can safely reach Moonrise Towers.
We learned about a place nearby that is protected from the shadow curse. The people there may know how to get to Moonrise Towers safely.
Harpers are trying to discover how the Absolute's cultists safely traverse the shadow curse. If we help them, we might find a way to reach Moonrise Towers.
We met a group of Harper scouts travelling through the shadow-cursed lands, and defended them against shadows. Grateful, one of them showed us where to find a safe haven nearby.

We reached Last Light Inn, a safe haven in the shadow-cursed lands. Jaheira, the Harpers' leader, let us in after we gained her trust. We should see what we can learn from the occupants about the Absolute.
We met the cleric Isobel. She said that our parasites could help us infiltrate the cult of the Absolute and find the source of Ketheric's power.
We met Marcus, a True Soul instructed to abduct the cleric Isobel from Last Light Inn and take her to Moonrise Towers.
We saved Isobel from being abducted by Marcus for the Absolute. She said that our parasites could allow us to infiltrate the ranks of the cult of the Absolute.
Jaheira, the Harpers' leader, told us to go to Moonrise Towers and infiltrate the ranks of the cult of the Absolute.
Last Light Inn and its occupants were consumed by the shadow curse. It is no longer safe.

objectives.title: Infiltrate the cult of the Absolute.
journalEntries: We reached Moonrise Towers. We need to infiltrate the cult's ranks and find the source of these parasites.
We were granted entry to Moonrise Towers. The guards believe us to be True Souls, and have sent to speak to a high-ranking cultist named Z'rell.
We witnessed a goblin attack Ketheric Thorm, the Absolute's Chosen, and strike a fatal blow. Ketheric recovered almost instantly. Something is making him invulnerable.
Disciple Z'rell wants to entrust us with a task - this could be our chance to further infiltrate the cult's ranks. We are to meet her upstairs at Moonrise Towers.
Disciple Z'rell has asked us to find out what has happened to Ketheric Thorm's advisor, Balthazar - and, more importantly, find the relic he was sent to retrieve.
We killed Disciple Z'rell. Whatever task she had for us, it won't help us to learn more about the cult now. We should search the tower for another way.
We found Balthazar's diary and learned that he went on a mission to the Thorm Mausoleum to find the 'Nightsong'. This Nightsong seems to be the key to his invulnerability. We should follow this lead.
Disciple Z'rell was impressed that we captured the cleric Isobel. She reminded us that Balthazar is our current priority.
We found Balthazar in the temple below the Thorm Mausoleum. He asked us to help him find the relic for Ketheric.
We learned that the relic Balthazar is hunting is the source of Ketheric's invulnerability.
We found the 'relic' that is the key to Ketheric's invulnerability. It is a living aasimar called Nightsong, caged in the Shadowfell.
We helped Balthazar return Nightsong to Moonrise Towers. Disciple Z'rell would be happy to hear this.
Disciple Z'rell was pleased that we helped return Nightsong to Moonrise Towers. She has now asked us to kidnap the cleric Isobel from Last Light Inn.
We successfully captured Isobel. This should please Disciple Z'rell enough for her to grant us an audience with the Absolute.
We were unsuccessful in our mission to capture Isobel. Disciple Z'rell will not be pleased to hear that Isobel died.

We told Ketheric of our success in retrieving the Nightsong. He wasn't pleased by our methods, and gave us an option - kneel at the altar and brave the Absolute's judgement, or go to Last Light and capture the cleric Isobel for him.

objectives.title: Investigate Moonrise Towers.
journalEntries: With Moonrise Towers hostile to us, infiltration is no longer an option. We should search the tower ourselves to see what we can learn about the Absolute and the source of our parasites.
We attacked Ketheric, but we cannot harm him so long as he is invulnerable. We need to find the source of his protection and strip it from him.

objectives.title: Defeat the cult of the Absolute.
journalEntries: We found the necromancer Balthazar in the temple below the Thorm Mausoleum. He is looking for a relic for Ketheric Thorm. We should make sure we find it first.

We defeated the necromancer Balthazar, failing to assist him in his mission to retrieve a relic for Ketheric. The relic is clearly important for the Absolute. Finding it ourselves may help us against the cult.

objectives.title: Request an audience with Ketheric Thorm.
journalEntries: We succeeded in capturing Isobel at Last Light Inn and sending her to Moonrise Towers. We should report to Ketheric.

We failed to capture Isobel, but because of our success with Nightsong, Disciple Z'rell has granted us an audience with Ketheric Thorm. He will be the one to pass judgement upon us. We can find him on the roof of Moonrise.
Disciple Z'rell was pleased that we successfully captured both Nightsong and Isobel. She has granted us an audience with Ketheric Thorm on the roof of Moonrise.

objectives.title: Receive judgement at the altar of the Absolute.
journalEntries: We met with Ketheric Thorm on the roof of Moonrise. He is upset that his daughter Isobel is dead. He has told us to kneel at the Absolute's altar to receive judgement.
We met with Ketheric Thorm on the roof of Moonrise. He is pleased with our work and has granted us an audience with the Absolute. We can kneel at the altar in Her name.

We forced our way onto the roof of Moonrise to speak with Ketheric Thorm. Though he is pleased we captured Nightsong, he is not impressed with our disregard for orders. He has told us we can either go back out to retrieve Isobel for him, or kneel at the Absolute's altar to beg forgiveness.

objectives.title: Assault Moonrise Towers.
journalEntries: We killed Nightsong, so Ketheric Thorm is now vulnerable. This is our time to strike.
We freed Nightsong and she flew across the shadow-cursed lands toward Moonrise Towers. She seeks to wreak vengeance on Ketheric Thorm.
We met with Jaheira at the entrance to Moonrise. She and her Harpers are ready to help us with the assault, and to end Ketheric Thorm.

objectives.title: Confront Ketheric Thorm.
journalEntries: We reached Moonrise Towers, where Nightsong has launched a siege. We will need to fight our way to Ketheric Thorm if we want to find the source of the power behind the parasites.
We reached Moonrise Towers. With Nightsong dead, we will need to fight our way to Ketheric Thorm if we want to find the source of the power behind the parasites.
Moonrise Towers is under siege. It's time to end Ketheric Thorm and the cult of the Absolute.

objectives.title: Defeat Ketheric Thorm.
journalEntries: We attacked Ketheric Thorm on the rooftop of Moonrise Towers.

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: We did battle with Ketheric Thorm. Before we could defeat him, we were interrupted by a giant tentacle that carried Ketheric away - and Nightsong with him.
We knelt at the altar for our audience with the Absolute. A great tentacled beast rose from beneath the tower, and transported us somewhere below.

entries.name: Rescue the Tieflings
entries.description: We learned from Alfira that some of the tieflings were taken to Moonrise Towers. She's asked us to save them.

objectives.title: Find out where the tieflings are being held in Moonrise Towers.
journalEntries: We learned from Alfira that some of the tieflings were taken to Moonrise Towers. She's asked us to save them.
We learned from Cerys that some of the other tieflings were taken to Moonrise Towers. We should investigate.
Rolan's brother and sister were kidnapped by cultists, along with some of the other tieflings. They're likely being held at Moonrise Towers. We should investigate.
We learned from Alfira that some of the other tieflings were taken to Moonrise Towers. We should investigate.
Bex's lover was one of the tieflings taken by cultists. She's lost without him.
Rolan's brother and sister were among the tiefling kidnapped by the cultists. He hasn't taken it well.
We ran into Alfira. Upset, she told us what happened in the darkness. She asked us to save her friends.
We learned from Bex that some of the tieflings, including her lover Danis, were taken to Moonrise Towers. We should investigate.

objectives.title: Break the tieflings out of captivity.
journalEntries: We met some tieflings from the Emerald Grove in the cells of Moonrise. Without us, they won't make it out alive.
We found the captured tieflings. They won't last long in Moonrise Towers. We should find a way to help them escape.

objectives.title: Speak to the gnomes.
journalEntries: The gnomes have a plan to break out of the prison. We should speak to them.

objectives.title: Protect the gnomes.
journalEntries: The gnomes plan to free the captured tieflings. We should watch their backs.
The gnomes are on their way to free the tiefling captives. We need to protect them.

objectives.title: Assist the tieflings' escape through the tunnels.
journalEntries: The tieflings are making their escape through the tunnels behind their cell. It will be dangerous without our help.

objectives.title: Assist the tieflings' escape through prison.
journalEntries: The boat departed before everyone could board. Those left behind ran to find some other way out.
The tieflings are making their escape through the prison. It will be dangerous without our help.

objectives.title: Find the tieflings' safe harbour.
journalEntries: The tieflings escaped by boat. We should look for them - they must have landed somewhere.
We couldn't save all the tieflings, but some managed to escape using a boat. We should look for them - they must have landed somewhere.
The tieflings were all able to escape Moonrise Towers on foot. We should look for them - they must have found somewhere in the darkness to hide.
We couldn't save all the tieflings, but some were able to escape Moonrise Towers on foot. We should look for them - they must have found somewhere in the darkness to hide.

objectives.title: Meet the tieflings in Last Light.
journalEntries: The tieflings escaped using a boat found in the tunnels of Moonrise Towers. We should meet them back in Last Light.
We couldn't save all the tieflings, but some managed to escape using a boat. We should reunite with the survivors back in Last Light.
All the tieflings escaped Moonrise Towers. We should meet them back in Last Light.
We couldn't save all the tieflings. The few who survived fled on foot. We should meet them back in Last Light.

objectives.title: Speak to the tieflings.
journalEntries: The tieflings arrived safely in Last Light. We should speak to them.
We found Last Light - a sanctuary in the shadow-cursed lands. Maybe the tieflings are here.
Alfira thanked us for rescuing her friends from Moonrise Towers.
Alfira was devastated to learn what happened in Moonrise Towers, but thanked us for doing what we could to save her friends.
Rolan thanked us for saving his family.
Bex thanked us for reuniting her with her lover, Danis.
Rolan departed Last Light to look for his siblings. Per his message, they'll wait for his return, but they're worried.
Rolan thanked us for reuniting him with his surviving family. They can now mourn their lost sibling together.
Rolan's reunion with his sibling didn't go as expected, and they separated on bad terms.

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: We failed to rescue the tieflings from Moonrise Towers.
The tieflings all escaped from Moonrise Towers.
We couldn't save all the tieflings, but some were able to escape Moonrise Towers.
We didn't save the tieflings. It is doubtful that they survived Moonrise Towers.
We never found the tieflings in Moonrise Towers.
The tieflings were brought together again in Last Light before it was razed to the ground.
We couldn't save all the tieflings, but those who survived managed to escape using a boat found in the tunnels of Moonrise Towers.
The tieflings escaped using a boat found in the tunnels of Moonrise Towers.
The tieflings are finally safe from the horrors of Moonrise Towers.
The tieflings are safe, but Rolan is nowhere to be found at Last Light Inn. His family is worried.

entries.name: Rescue Wulbren
entries.description: We freed the deep gnomes in Grymforge, but more of their kin were taken to Moonrise Towers - including their leader Wulbren. We need to find and rescue them.

objectives.title: Travel to Moonrise Towers.
journalEntries: We freed the deep gnomes in Grymforge, but more of their kin were taken to Moonrise Towers - including their leader Wulbren. We need to find and rescue them.
We learned from Barcus that his friend Wulbren is being held captive in Moonrise Towers. If we free him, Barcus has offered to make us something remarkable.
We agreed to save Barcus' friend, Wulbren, and the Ironhand gnomes he leads, from Moonrise Towers.

objectives.title: Break the gnomes out of jail.
journalEntries: We found Wulbren and his fellow gnomes. They won't last long in Moonrise Towers without our help.

objectives.title: Give Wulbren something that can break stone.
journalEntries: Wulbren has plans to break out, but he needs our help. The Warden confiscated their weapons, but anything that can break rock will do. Whatever we find, we need to pass it to him - discreetly.

objectives.title: Cover the gnomes' escape.
journalEntries: The gnomes have broken free and are on their way to rescue the tieflings. We should watch their backs.

objectives.title: Help the gnomes escape.
journalEntries: The gnomes are making their escape through the tunnels, but they're not safe yet. We need to watch their backs.
The gnomes are making their escape through Moonrise Towers itself. Without our help, they'll surely die.

objectives.title: Find Wulbren.
journalEntries: Wulbren fled Moonrise Towers on foot - hopefully he'll find refuge somewhere.
Wulbren fled Moonrise Towers by boat - hopefully he'll find refuge somewhere.

objectives.title: Return to Last Light.
journalEntries: Wulbren fled Moonrise Towers - hopefully he'll find refuge in Last Light Inn. Barcus will be thrilled. We should check up on them.

objectives.title: Talk to Wulbren.
journalEntries: We found Last Light - a safe haven in the darkness. Perhaps Wulbren is here.
We've defeated Ketheric. Wulbren has some thoughts. We should speak to him at Moonrise Towers.

objectives.title: Talk to Barcus.
journalEntries: Wulbren has arrived safely in Last Light. We should let Barcus know.
We told Barcus the good news. He ran to find Wulbren immediately.
Wulbren is dead. We should tell Barcus.

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: Wulbren treated us coldly after his rescue, but rewarded us anyway.
Relieved that Wulbren is safe, Barcus rewarded us.
Wulbren is dead.
We never found the prisoners in Moonrise Towers.
We abandoned the gnomes to their fate.
Last Light was destroyed. Hopefully Wulbren escaped.
We left the shadow-cursed lands without telling Barcus about Wulbren. He will likely assume his friend is dead.
Wulbren apologised for how he acted at Last Light. He told us the Ironhand Gnomes plan to save Baldur's Gate, and he wants us to be part of it.

entries.name: Resolve the Abduction
entries.description: Marcus, a True Soul who has infiltrated Last Light, told us that his powerful master demands that the cleric Isobel be taken to Moonrise Towers alive. If we do this, Last Light will no longer be protected from the shadow curse.

objectives.title: Go to Last Light Inn.
journalEntries: Z'rell ordered us to kidnap Isobel, a cleric hiding out at Last Light Inn. An agent of the Absolute is there, keeping close watch on her.

objectives.title: Help Marcus capture Isobel.
journalEntries: Marcus, a True Soul who has infiltrated Last Light, told us that his powerful master demands that the cleric Isobel be taken to Moonrise Towers alive. If we do this, Last Light will no longer be protected from the shadow curse.
A winged Flaming Fist who serves the Absolute swooped in to try and abduct Isobel. We decided to side with him.
Z'rell asked us to return to Last Light and help Marcus kidnap Isobel. If we do this, we will gain an audience with Ketheric.

objectives.title: Protect Isobel from Marcus.
journalEntries: A winged Flaming Fist who serves the Absolute swooped in to try and abduct Isobel. We decided to help Isobel fight him off.
We refused to help Marcus abduct Isobel, and instead helped her fight him off.
We attacked Marcus after he told us about his plan to abduct Isobel.
We warned Jaheira about Marcus' plan to abduct Isobel. We should help her terminate Marcus before he can carry out his plan.

objectives.title: Report to Z'rell.
journalEntries: We helped Marcus abduct Isobel, and she was carried off to Moonrise Towers. Z'rell will be pleased.

objectives.title: Report to Ketheric.
journalEntries: We helped Marcus abduct Isobel, and she was carried off to Moonrise Towers. This should earn us an audience with Ketheric.

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: We prevented Marcus from abducting Isobel. Why would the cult want her alive?
We weren't able to save Isobel from Marcus, the True Soul who infiltrated Last Light. When she was captured, the shield protecting Last Light collapsed.
We helped Marcus abduct Isobel and carry her off to Moonrise Towers.
When we killed Nightsong, Last Light fell to the shadow curse. Isobel died in the subsequent battle.
We angered the denizens of Moonrise Towers; it seems unlikely that anyone there will still want to reward us for abducting Isobel.
We freed Nightsong, and Moonrise Towers is now under attack. It is unlikely we will be welcomed there.
We reported back on Isobel's kidnapping. Z'rell has granted us an audience with Ketheric.
We reported back on Isobel's kidnapping to Ketheric himself.

entries.name: Seek Protection from the Shadow Curse
entries.description: A deadly curse plagues this land. One wrong step could kill us. The shadow curse is even stronger in certain areas. We need to find a way to fend it off.
entries.wikiTitle: Seek Protection from the Shadow Curse

objectives.title: Find a way to protect yourself from the curse.
journalEntries: A deadly curse plagues this land. One wrong step could kill us.
The shadow curse is even stronger in certain areas. We need to find a way to fend it off.
Light protects us from the shadow curse, but its effect is limited. We should find a better form of protection.
A deadly shadow curse plagues this land. Nere had a Moonlantern to protect himself from it. We may need to find something similar if we want to survive.
We found a Moonlantern, a device that can protect us from the shadow curse. Unfortunately, it is broken beyond repair.
We met a drider who carries a Moonlantern that protects him from the shadow curse. If we get one for ourselves, we will be able to travel the deepest parts of the curse unharmed.
One of our companions transformed into a cursed shadow-creature.

We found a note about cultists travelling through the deepest parts of the curse - unharmed. They must have some way to protect themselves. The owner of the note came from somewhere called Last Light.

objectives.title: Defeat the cultists.
journalEntries: While travelling with cultists, they were attacked by the Harpers. We decided to help the Harpers, and fought against the cultists.
The drider dropped his Moonlantern during the fight. It's ours now.

objectives.title: Speak to the Harpers.
journalEntries: We helped the Harpers defeat the cultists.

objectives.title: Reach Last Light Inn.
journalEntries: We helped a group of Harpers who were attacked by shadows. They told us about a place nearby that is protected from the shadow curse.
We learned of a safe haven in the shadow-cursed lands - Last Light Inn. We should pay it a visit.
The Harpers took the Moonlantern, and asked us to meet them at Last Light. They want to introduce us to their leader.

objectives.title: Talk to Jaheira.
journalEntries: We reached Last Light Inn and met Jaheira, the leader of the Harpers. We should see what we can learn about traversing the shadow curse safely.

objectives.title: Get help from the cleric Isobel.
journalEntries: Jaheira told us to speak to a cleric called Isobel for help traversing the shadow curse. Isobel protects Last Light from the shadow curse.

objectives.title: Find stronger protection from the shadow curse.
journalEntries: Isobel granted us Selûne's divine blessing, which can protect us from all but the strongest areas of the shadow curse.

objectives.title: Speak to the Harpers outside Last Light.
journalEntries: Isobel said the cultists can traverse the shadow curse safely - even the deepest parts. Some Harpers are looking into it. We should meet them at the bridge outside Last Light.

objectives.title: Find protection from the shadow curse.
journalEntries: With Isobel gone, Last Light Inn is no longer protected from the shadow curse.

objectives.title: Go to the ambush site.
journalEntries: The cultists have a lantern that protects them from the shadow curse. The Harpers can help us seize it in an ambush. We should meet them at the ambush site.

objectives.title: Talk to the Harpers at the ambush site.
journalEntries: We reached the ambush site. The cultists should be here soon.

objectives.title: Ambush the convoy.
journalEntries: We found cultists bearing a powerful lantern. If we want the lantern, we need to handle the cultists first.
The Harpers were defeated, but we might still find the cultists and the lantern at the ambush site.
We found a note on one of the Harpers. It was orders from Jaheira to take out a group of cultists. We should investigate the ambush site.

objectives.title: Defeat the convoy.
journalEntries: We attacked the convoy of Absolute cultists.

objectives.title: Take the drider's Moonlantern.
journalEntries: We met a drider who carries a Moonlantern that protects him from the shadow curse. If we get one for ourselves, we will be able to travel the deepest parts of the curse unharmed.

objectives.title: Defend the cultists.
journalEntries: We betrayed the Harpers, and allied ourselves with the drider.

objectives.title: Find a Moonlantern.
journalEntries: We decided to join the cultists heading to Moonrise Towers. If we wish to travel without them, we will need to find a way to protect ourselves from the curse.
We reached Moonrise Towers. However, if we wish to travel the shadow-cursed lands ourselves, we will need to find protection from the curse.

objectives.title: Find Balthazar's Moonlantern.
journalEntries: Disciple Z'rell told us that Ketheric's advisor, a man called Balthazar, has a Moonlantern in his chambers. It will protect us from the deepest parts of shadow curse.

objectives.title: Take the Moonlantern.
journalEntries: The drider dropped the Moonlantern. Now's our chance to take it.
We tricked the drider into giving us the Moonlantern and forced him into the darkness. The lantern is ours - as is its protection from the shadow curse.

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: The Harpers died. We should retrieve the Moonlantern from them.
We defeated the drider. We can take the Moonlantern and use it to traverse the deepest parts of the shadow curse.
We claimed the drider's Moonlantern. We should now be protected from the shadow curse.
We reached Last Light Inn and met the cleric Isobel. She gave us the Moonlantern from the drider we defeated. We should now be protected from even the deepest parts of shadow curse.
We travelled through the shadow-cursed lands without finding our own Moonlantern.
We found a Moonlantern. This will protect us from even the deepest parts of the curse.

We got a Moonlantern and discovered that it was powered by the magic of a pixie inside. We decided to release her. In return, she gave us a bell that can protect us from the deepest parts of the shadow curse.

entries.name: Deal with the Gnomes
entries.description: We agreed to help Manip Falcäo track down and kill the gnomes attacking their checkpoint. He promised to reward us if we bring him the head of their leader. We should find the gnomes' hideout.

objectives.title: Find the gnomes' hideout.
journalEntries: We agreed to help Manip Falcäo track down and kill the gnomes attacking their checkpoint. He promised to reward us if we bring him the head of their leader. We should find the gnomes' hideout.

objectives.title: Cut down the gnomes.
journalEntries: We found the gnomes' hideout. We need to find the leader and take his head.

objectives.title: Take Wulbren's head.
journalEntries: Wulbren, the leader of the gnomes, died.

objectives.title: Bring Wulbren's head to Manip Falcäo.
journalEntries: We got Wulbren's head. We should bring it back to Manip Falcäo.

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: We brought Wulbren's head to Manip Falcäo and were rewarded for it.
We ended up on bad terms with Manip Falcäo. The deal is off.
Manip Falcäo died. There is no one to reward us for killing the leader of the gnomes anymore.
We abandoned the task given to us by Manip Falcäo. We must press on.
We failed to bring the gnome leader's head to Manip Falcäo.

entries.name: Feed the Mind Flayer
entries.description: A ravenous mind flayer asked us to bring it a humanoid to feast on.

objectives.title: Kill a humanoid and pick up the body.
journalEntries: A ravenous mind flayer asked us to bring it a humanoid to feast on.

objectives.title: Bring the body to the mind flayer.
journalEntries: We killed a humanoid for the mind flayer - hopefully this will sate its hunger.

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: We defeated the mind flayer.
We convinced the starving mind flayer to hunt for its food.
We left without helping the mind flayer.
The now-sated mind flayer granted us a boon of psionic power.

entries.name: Find a Way into Wyrm's Rock Fortress
entries.description: Wyrm's Rock is closed due to the ordination of Gortash - who is about to become Archduke of Baldur's Gate. There must be someone, or something, in Wyrm's Crossing that could help us gain entry.
entries.wikiTitle: Find a Way into Wyrm's Rock Fortress

objectives.title: Find a way to get into Wyrm's Rock Fortress.
journalEntries: Wyrm's Rock is closed due to the ordination of Gortash - who is about to become Archduke of Baldur's Gate. There must be someone, or something, in Wyrm's Crossing that could help us gain entry.

objectives.title: Enter Wyrm's Rock Fortress through the secret entrance.
journalEntries: We found a map that details a secret entrance into Wyrm's Rock. That could be our way in.

objectives.title: Enter Wyrm's Rock Fortress.
journalEntries: We found a report for Duke Ravengard at the Posthouse. This should let us enter Wyrm's Rock.
We have an admission pass to the ordination. This should let us enter Wyrm's Rock.
Valeria gave us an admission pass to the ordination. This should let us enter Wyrm's Rock.
We convinced the guards to let us into Wyrm's Rock for Gortash's coronation.

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: We made our way into Wyrm's Rock, where Gortash is about to become Archduke.

entries.name: Find Dribbles the Clown
entries.description: Dribbles the Clown, star of the circus, is missing. Ringmaster Lucretious asked us to find him. He's likely dead, but that doesn't seem to bother her.

objectives.title: Investigate the Circus.
journalEntries: Dribbles the Clown, star of the circus, is missing. Ringmaster Lucretious asked us to find him. He's likely dead, but that doesn't seem to bother her.

objectives.title: Find Dribbles.
journalEntries: We spoke to the doppelganger who impersonated the clown. He admitted he killed the real Dribbles the Clown.
Ringmaster Lucretious asked us to find the corpse of her star - Dribbles the Clown. Or what's left of him, at least.

objectives.title: Collect Dribbles' body parts.
journalEntries: A part of Dribbles has been used to create a gruesome art piece. We should continue searching for his body parts.
The dead doppelganger revealed that their mistress wanted the clown's body parts for her 'art'.
We found a severed hand in the circus shop run by Popper the kobold. It looks like it belonged to Dribbles the Clown.
We found Dribbles' torso.
We found Dribbles' pelvis.
Based on how Dribbles has been cut up, it looks like we've found about half of his corpse.
We found Dribbles' arm.
We found Dribbles' leg.
We found Dribbles' foot.
We need just one final piece to complete Dribbles.
We found Dribbles' head.

objectives.title: Return to Ringmaster Lucretious.
journalEntries: We have all of Dribbles' body parts. We should bring them to Ringmaster Lucretious.

objectives.title: Quest Complete
journalEntries: Lucretious thanked us for our help. She intends to raise Dribbles from the dead - with some improvements. The circus will soon leave Wyrm's Crossing.
We left without helping Ringmaster Lucretious and Dribbles the Clown.
Lucretious has been defeated.
The circus vanished. Dribbles the Clown will never perform again.

entries.name: Find the Missing Letters
